sentences.zh: 求天正冬至：置上元距所求積年，以期實乘之，為天正冬至氣積分；

translations.literal: To find the winter solstice of the celestial standard year: set the accumulated years from upper origin to the target year, multiply by the period dividend to obtain the accumulated parts for the celestial-standard winter solstice qi;
translations.idiomatic: To find the winter solstice of the celestial standard year (tian zheng dongzhi): set the accumulated years from upper origin to the target year, multiply by the period dividend (qi shi) to obtain the qi accumulated parts for the celestial-standard winter solstice;

sentences.zh: 滿旬周去之，不滿，如日法而一為大餘，不盡為小餘。

translations.literal: cast out full ten-day circuits; divide the remainder by the day divisor for the greater remainder, with the unfilled portion as the lesser remainder.
translations.idiomatic: cast out full ten-day circuits (xun zhou); divide the remainder by the day divisor (ri fa) for the greater remainder (da yu), with the unfilled portion as the lesser remainder (xiao yu).

sentences.zh: 其大餘命己卯，算外，即所求年天正冬至日辰及餘。

translations.literal: count the greater remainder from jimao (outside the count) to obtain the day, hour, and remainder of the celestial-standard winter solstice for the target year.
translations.idiomatic: count the greater remainder from jimao (outside the count) to obtain the day, double-hour, and remainder of the celestial-standard winter solstice for the target year.

sentences.zh: 求次氣：置天正冬至大、小餘，以氣策加之，四分之一為少，之二為半，之三為太。

translations.literal: To find successive qi: set the winter solstice greater and lesser remainders and add the qi stride; one-fourth counts as minor, two-fourths as half, three-fourths as major.
translations.idiomatic: To find successive qi (ci qi): set the winter solstice greater and lesser remainders and add the qi stride (qi ce); one-fourth counts as minor (shao), two-fourths as half (ban), three-fourths as major (tai).

sentences.zh: 如滿秒母，收從小余，小余滿日法從大余，大余盈紀法乃去之。

translations.literal: when seconds fill the second parent, carry into the lesser remainder; when the lesser remainder fills the day divisor, carry into the greater remainder; when the greater remainder exceeds the era divisor, cast it out.
translations.idiomatic: when seconds fill the second parent (miao mu), carry into the lesser remainder; when the lesser remainder fills the day divisor, carry into the greater remainder; when the greater remainder exceeds the era divisor (ji fa), cast it out.

sentences.zh: 去命如前，即次氣日辰及餘。

translations.literal: name and cast out as before to obtain the day, hour, and remainder of the next qi.
translations.idiomatic: name and cast out as before to obtain the day, double-hour, and remainder of the next qi.

sentences.zh: 求天正經朔：置天正冬至氣積分，以朔實去之，不盡，為天正閏餘；

translations.literal: To find the canonical new moon of the celestial standard year: set the winter solstice qi accumulated parts, divide by the new-moon dividend; the remainder is the celestial-standard intercalary remainder;
translations.idiomatic: To find the canonical new moon of the celestial standard year (tian zheng jing shuo): set the winter solstice qi accumulated parts, divide by the new-moon dividend (shuo shi); the remainder is the celestial-standard intercalary remainder (run yu);

sentences.zh: 用減氣積分，餘為天正十一月經朔加時積分。

translations.literal: subtract it from the qi accumulated parts; the remainder is the accumulated parts at the canonical new-moon moment of month 11 of the celestial standard year.
translations.idiomatic: subtract it from the qi accumulated parts; the remainder is the accumulated parts at the canonical new-moon moment of celestial-standard month 11.

sentences.zh: 滿旬周去之，不滿，如日法而一為大餘，不盡為小餘。

translations.literal: cast out full ten-day circuits; divide the remainder by the day divisor for the greater remainder, with the unfilled portion as the lesser remainder.
translations.idiomatic: cast out full ten-day circuits; divide the remainder by the day divisor for the greater remainder, with the unfilled portion as the lesser remainder.

sentences.zh: 其大餘命己卯，算外，即所求年天正十一月經朔日辰及餘。

translations.literal: count the greater remainder from jimao (outside the count) to obtain the day, hour, and remainder of the celestial-standard canonical new moon of month 11 for the target year.
translations.idiomatic: count the greater remainder from jimao (outside the count) to obtain the day, double-hour, and remainder of the celestial-standard canonical new moon of month 11 for the target year.

sentences.zh: 求弦望及次朔經日：置天正經朔大、小餘，以弦策累加之，去命如前，即各得弦、望及次朔經日辰及餘。

translations.literal: To find quarter-moon, full-moon, and successive canonical days: set the celestial-standard canonical new moon greater and lesser remainders and add the quarter-moon stride cumulatively; name and cast out as before to obtain the day, hour, and remainder of each quarter-moon, full moon, and successive canonical new moon.
translations.idiomatic: To find quarter-moon, full-moon, and successive canonical days: set the celestial-standard canonical new moon greater and lesser remainders and add the quarter-moon stride (xian ce) cumulatively; name and cast out as before to obtain the day, double-hour, and remainder of each quarter-moon, full moon, and successive canonical new moon.

sentences.zh: 求沒日：置有沒常氣小余，凡常氣小餘在沒限已上者，為有沒之氣。

translations.literal: To find submergence days: set the lesser remainder of the constant qi that bears submergence; whenever a constant qi's lesser remainder reaches the submergence limit or above, that qi has a submergence day.
translations.idiomatic: To find submergence days (mo ri): set the lesser remainder of the constant qi that bears submergence; whenever a constant qi's lesser remainder reaches the submergence limit (mo xian) or above, that qi has a submergence day.

sentences.zh: 六十乘之，用減四十四萬三千七百七十一，余滿六千三百七十一而一為日，不滿為餘。

translations.literal: multiply by 60, subtract from 443,771; divide the remainder by 6,371 for days, with the unfilled portion as the remainder.
translations.idiomatic: multiply by 60, subtract from 443,771; divide the remainder by 6,371 for days, with the unfilled portion as the remainder.

sentences.zh: 命日起其氣初日辰，算外，即為氣內沒日辰。

translations.literal: count the days outward from the opening day and hour of that qi (outside the count) to obtain the submergence day and hour within the qi.
translations.idiomatic: count the days outward from the opening day and double-hour of that qi (outside the count) to obtain the submergence day and hour within the qi.

sentences.zh: 求滅日：置有滅經朔小餘，凡經朔小餘不滿朔虛分者，為有滅之朔。

translations.literal: To find extinction days: set the lesser remainder of the canonical new moon that bears extinction; whenever a canonical new moon's lesser remainder falls short of the new-moon void fraction, that month has an extinction day.
translations.idiomatic: To find extinction days (mie ri): set the lesser remainder of the canonical new moon that bears extinction; whenever a canonical new moon's lesser remainder falls short of the new-moon void fraction (shuo xu fen), that month has an extinction day.

sentences.zh: 三十乘之，滿朔虛分而一為日，不滿為餘。

translations.literal: multiply by 30; divide by the new-moon void fraction for days, with the unfilled portion as the remainder.
translations.idiomatic: multiply by 30; divide by the new-moon void fraction for days, with the unfilled portion as the remainder.

sentences.zh: 命日起其月經朔日辰，算外，即為月內滅日辰。

translations.literal: count the days outward from the canonical new moon day and hour of that month (outside the count) to obtain the extinction day and hour within the month.
translations.idiomatic: count the days outward from the canonical new moon day and double-hour of that month (outside the count) to obtain the extinction day and hour within the month.

translations.literal: Procedures for expansion and contraction.
translations.idiomatic: Procedures for expansion and contraction (bu fa lian).

translations.literal: Hou stride: 5, remainder 530, 55 seconds.
translations.idiomatic: Hou stride (hou ce): 5 days, remainder 530 parts, 55 seconds.

sentences.zh: 卦策：六、餘六百三十七、秒六。

translations.literal: Hexagram stride: 6, remainder 637, 6 seconds.
translations.idiomatic: Hexagram stride (gua ce): 6 days, remainder 637 parts, 6 seconds.

translations.literal: Earth ruler stride: 3, remainder 318, 33 seconds.
translations.idiomatic: Earth ruler stride (tu wang ce): 3 days, remainder 318 parts, 33 seconds.

translations.literal: Year intercalation: 79,290.
translations.idiomatic: Year intercalation (sui run): 79,290.

sentences.zh: 月閏：六千六百七半。

translations.literal: Month intercalation: 6,607 half.
translations.idiomatic: Month intercalation (yue run): 6,607½.

sentences.zh: 閏限：二十萬八千六百七十半。

translations.literal: Intercalation limit: 208,670 half.
translations.idiomatic: Intercalation limit (run xian): 208,670½.

sentences.zh: 辰法：一千二百一十五。

translations.literal: Chen divisor: 1,215.
translations.idiomatic: Chen divisor (chen fa): 1,215.

sentences.zh: 半辰法：六百七半。

translations.literal: Half-chen divisor: 607 half.
translations.idiomatic: Half-chen divisor (ban chen fa): 607½.

sentences.zh: 刻法：七百二十九。

translations.literal: Ke divisor: 729.
translations.idiomatic: Ke divisor (ke fa): 729.

sentences.zh: 秒法：六十。

translations.literal: Second divisor: 60.
translations.idiomatic: Second divisor (miao fa): 60.

sentences.zh: 求七十二候：各置中節大、小餘命之，為初候；

translations.literal: To find the seventy-two hou: for each, set the major and minor remainders of the mid-node and designate them as the first hou;
translations.idiomatic: To find the seventy-two hou: for each mid-node, set its major and minor remainders and designate them as the first hou;

sentences.zh: 以候策加之為次候；

translations.literal: add the hou stride to obtain the next hou;
translations.idiomatic: add the hou stride (hou ce) to obtain the next hou;

sentences.zh: 又加之為末候。

translations.literal: add again to obtain the final hou.
translations.idiomatic: add again to obtain the final hou.

sentences.zh: 各命己卯，算外，即得所求日辰。

translations.literal: for each, count from jimao (outside the count) to obtain the requested day and hour.
translations.idiomatic: for each, count from jimao (outside the count) to obtain the requested day and double-hour.

sentences.zh: 求六十四卦：各置中氣大、小餘命之，為公卦用事日；

translations.literal: To find the sixty-four hexagrams: for each, set the major and minor remainders of the mid-qi and designate them as the day when the duke hexagram takes effect;
translations.idiomatic: To find the sixty-four hexagrams: for each mid-qi, set its major and minor remainders and designate them as the day when the duke hexagram (gong gua) takes effect;

sentences.zh: 以卦策加之，得辟卦用事日；

translations.literal: add the hexagram stride to obtain the day when the lord hexagram takes effect;
translations.idiomatic: add the hexagram stride (gua ce) to obtain the day when the lord hexagram (bi gua) takes effect;

sentences.zh: 又加之，得諸侯內卦用事日；

translations.literal: add again to obtain the day when the marquis inner hexagram takes effect;
translations.idiomatic: add again to obtain the day when the marquis inner hexagram (zhuhou nei gua) takes effect;

sentences.zh: 以土王策加之，得十有二節之初諸侯外卦用事日；

translations.literal: add the earth ruler stride to obtain the day when the marquis outer hexagram takes effect at the opening of the twelve qi-periods;
translations.idiomatic: add the earth ruler stride (tu wang ce) to obtain the day when the marquis outer hexagram (zhuhou wai gua) takes effect at the opening of the twelve qi-periods;

sentences.zh: 又加之，得大夫卦用事日；

translations.literal: add again to obtain the day when the grandee hexagram takes effect;
translations.idiomatic: add again to obtain the day when the grandee hexagram (dafu gua) takes effect;

sentences.zh: 復以卦策加之，得卿卦用事日。

translations.literal: add the hexagram stride again to obtain the day when the minister hexagram takes effect.
translations.idiomatic: add the hexagram stride again to obtain the day when the minister hexagram (qing gua) takes effect.

sentences.zh: 各命己卯，算外，即得所求日辰。

translations.literal: for each, count from jimao (outside the count) to obtain the requested day and hour.
translations.idiomatic: for each, count from jimao (outside the count) to obtain the requested day and double-hour.

sentences.zh: 求五行用事：各因四立之節大、小餘命之，即春木、夏火、秋金、冬水首用事日。

translations.literal: To find the dominion of the five phases: for each, take the major and minor remainders of the four establishment nodes and designate them to obtain the first dominion days of spring wood, summer fire, autumn metal, and winter water.
translations.idiomatic: To find the dominion of the five phases (wuxing yong shi): for each, take the major and minor remainders of the four establishment nodes (si li) and designate them to obtain the first dominion days of spring wood, summer fire, autumn metal, and winter water.

sentences.zh: 以土王策減四季中氣大、小餘，即其季土始用事之日。

translations.literal: subtract the earth ruler stride from each season's mid-qi major and minor remainders to obtain the day when earth first takes dominion in that season.
translations.idiomatic: subtract the earth ruler stride from each season's mid-qi major and minor remainders to obtain the day when earth first takes dominion in that season.

sentences.zh: 各命己卯，算外，即得所求日辰。

translations.literal: for each, count from jimao (outside the count) to obtain the requested day and hour.
translations.idiomatic: for each, count from jimao (outside the count) to obtain the requested day and double-hour.

sentences.zh: 七十二候及卦目與前曆同。

translations.literal: The seventy-two hou and hexagram list are the same as in the preceding calendar.
translations.idiomatic: The seventy-two hou and hexagram list are the same as in the preceding calendar.

sentences.zh: 求中氣去經朔：置天正閏餘，以月閏累加之，滿日法為閏日，不滿為餘，即其月中氣去經朔日算。

translations.literal: To find the mid-qi's distance from the canonical new moon: set the celestial-standard intercalary remainder and add the month intercalation cumulatively; when the total fills the day divisor it makes an intercalary day, and the unfilled portion is the remainder—that is the count of days from the canonical new moon to the mid-qi in that month.
translations.idiomatic: To find the mid-qi's distance from the canonical new moon: set the celestial-standard intercalary remainder (run yu) and add the month intercalation (yue run) cumulatively; when the total fills the day divisor (ri fa) it makes an intercalary day, and the unfilled portion is the remainder—that is the count of days from the canonical new moon to the mid-qi in that month.

sentences.zh: 因求卦候者，各以卦、候策依次累加減之，中氣前減，中氣後加。

translations.literal: For those also seeking hexagrams and hou, add and subtract the hexagram and hou strides in sequence for each; subtract before the mid-qi and add after the mid-qi.
translations.idiomatic: For those also seeking hexagrams and hou, add and subtract the hexagram and hou strides in sequence for each; subtract before the mid-qi and add after the mid-qi.

sentences.zh: 各得其月卦、候去經朔日算。

translations.literal: Thus obtain for each month the count of days from the canonical new moon to the hexagram and hou.
translations.idiomatic: Thus obtain for each month the count of days from the canonical new moon to the hexagram and hou.

sentences.zh: 求發斂加時：置所求小餘，倍之，如辰法而一為辰數，不滿，五因之，如刻法而一為刻，不盡為分。

translations.literal: To find the added time of expansion and contraction: set the requested lesser remainder, double it, and divide by the chen divisor to obtain the chen number; if any remainder remains, multiply by five and divide by the ke divisor to obtain ke, with the unfilled portion as fen.
translations.idiomatic: To find the added time of expansion and contraction (fa lian jia shi): set the requested lesser remainder, double it, and divide by the chen divisor (chen fa) to obtain the chen number; if any remainder remains, multiply by five and divide by the ke divisor (ke fa) to obtain ke, with the unfilled portion as fen.

sentences.zh: 命辰數起子正，算外，即各得加時所在辰、刻及分。

translations.literal: count the chen number outward from midnight of zi (outside the count) to obtain the double-hour, ke, and fen of the added time.
translations.idiomatic: count the chen number outward from midnight of zi (zi zheng) (outside the count) to obtain the double-hour, ke, and fen of the added time.

sentences.zh: 如半辰數，即命起子初。

translations.literal: if the half-chen number is included, count from the beginning of the zi ke.
translations.idiomatic: if the half-chen number is included, count from the beginning of the zi ke (zi chu).

sentences.zh: 步日躔

translations.literal: Procedures for solar motion along the ecliptic.
translations.idiomatic: Procedures for solar motion along the ecliptic (bu ri chan).

sentences.zh: 周天分：二億一千三百一萬八千一十七。

translations.literal: Circuit-of-heaven parts: 213,018,017.
translations.idiomatic: Circuit-of-heaven parts (zhou tian fen): 213,018,017.

sentences.zh: 歲差：七千九百三十七。

translations.literal: Precession: 7,937.
translations.idiomatic: Precession (sui cha): 7,937.

sentences.zh: 周天度：三百六十五、約分二十五、秒七十二。

translations.literal: Circuit of heaven: 365 degrees, 25 fen, 72 seconds.
translations.idiomatic: Circuit of heaven (zhou tian du): 365° 25′ 72″.

translations.literal: Quadrant limit: 91 degrees, 31 fen, 9 seconds.
translations.idiomatic: Quadrant limit (xiang xian): 91° 31′ 9″.

sentences.zh: 乘法：一百一十九。

translations.literal: Multiplier: 119.
translations.idiomatic: Multiplier (cheng fa): 119.

sentences.zh: 除法：一千八百一十一。

translations.literal: Divisor: 1,811.
translations.idiomatic: Divisor (chu fa): 1,811.

sentences.zh: 秒法：一百。

translations.literal: Second divisor: 100.
translations.idiomatic: Second divisor (miao fa): 100.

sentences.zh: 求每日盈縮分先後數：置所求盈縮分，以乘法乘之，如除法而一，為其氣中平率；

translations.literal: To find the daily excess–deficit parts and sequence numbers: set the requested excess–deficit parts, multiply by the multiplier, and divide by the divisor to obtain the mid-qi mean rate for that qi;
translations.idiomatic: To find the daily excess–deficit parts (ying suo fen) and sequence numbers (xian hou shu): set the requested excess–deficit parts, multiply by the multiplier (cheng fa), and divide by the divisor (chu fa) to obtain the mid-qi mean rate (qi zhong ping lu) for that qi;

sentences.zh: 與後氣中平率相減，為合差；

translations.literal: subtract it from the next qi's mid-qi mean rate to obtain the combined difference;
translations.idiomatic: subtract it from the next qi's mid-qi mean rate to obtain the combined difference (he cha);

sentences.zh: 半合差，加減其氣中平率，為初、末泛率。

translations.literal: add or subtract half the combined difference from the mid-qi mean rate to obtain the initial and final general rates.
translations.idiomatic: add or subtract half the combined difference from the mid-qi mean rate to obtain the initial and final general rates (fan lu).

sentences.zh: 至後加為初、減為末，分後減為初、加為末。

translations.literal: After a solstice, add to the initial and subtract from the final; after an equinox, subtract from the initial and add to the final.
translations.idiomatic: After a solstice (zhi), add to the initial and subtract from the final; after an equinox (fen), subtract from the initial and add to the final.

sentences.zh: 又以乘法乘合差，如除法而一，為日差；

translations.literal: set the combined difference, multiply by the multiplier, and divide by the divisor to obtain the daily difference;
translations.idiomatic: set the combined difference, multiply by the multiplier, and divide by the divisor to obtain the daily difference (ri cha);

sentences.zh: 半日差，加減初、末泛率，為初、末定率。

translations.literal: add or subtract half the daily difference from the initial and final general rates to obtain the initial and final fixed rates.
translations.idiomatic: add or subtract half the daily difference from the initial and final general rates to obtain the initial and final fixed rates (ding lu).

sentences.zh: 至後減初加末，分後加初減末。

translations.literal: After a solstice, subtract from the initial and add to the final; after an equinox, add to the initial and subtract from the final.
translations.idiomatic: After a solstice, subtract from the initial and add to the final; after an equinox, add to the initial and subtract from the final.

sentences.zh: 以日差累加減其氣初定率，為每日盈縮分；

translations.literal: by cumulative daily difference add and subtract the qi's initial fixed rate to obtain the daily excess–deficit parts;
translations.idiomatic: by cumulative daily difference add and subtract the qi's initial fixed rate to obtain the daily excess–deficit parts;

sentences.zh: 至後減，分後加。

translations.literal: after a solstice subtract; after an equinox add.
translations.idiomatic: after a solstice subtract; after an equinox add.

sentences.zh: 各以每日盈縮分加減氣下先後數。

translations.literal: apply each day's excess–deficit parts to add and subtract the sequence numbers below each qi.
translations.idiomatic: apply each day's excess–deficit parts to add and subtract the sequence numbers (xian hou shu) below each qi.

sentences.zh: 冬至後，積盈為先，在縮減之；

translations.literal: After the winter solstice, accumulated surplus counts as early—where there is contraction, subtract;
translations.idiomatic: After the winter solstice, accumulated surplus counts as early (xian)—where there is contraction (suo), subtract;

sentences.zh: 夏至後，積縮為後，在盈減之。

translations.literal: after the summer solstice, accumulated contraction counts as late—where there is surplus, subtract.
translations.idiomatic: after the summer solstice, accumulated contraction counts as late (hou)—where there is surplus (ying), subtract.

sentences.zh: 其分、至前一氣，無後氣相減，皆因前氣合差為其氣合差。

translations.literal: For the qi before an equinox or solstice, when there is no following qi from which to subtract, always take the preceding qi's combined difference as that qi's combined difference.
translations.idiomatic: For the qi before an equinox or solstice, when there is no following qi from which to subtract, always take the preceding qi's combined difference as that qi's combined difference.

sentences.zh: 餘依前術，求朏朒仿此。

translations.literal: For the remainder, follow the preceding procedures; find deficit–surfeit by the same method.
translations.idiomatic: For the remainder, follow the preceding procedures; find deficit–surfeit (fei nei) by the same method.

sentences.zh: 求經朔弦望入氣：置天正閏日及餘，如氣策以下者，以減氣策，為入大雪氣；

translations.literal: To find qi entry for canonical new moon, quarter-moon, and full moon: set the celestial-standard intercalary day and remainder; if below the qi stride, subtract from the qi stride to obtain entry into Major Snow qi;
translations.idiomatic: To find qi entry for canonical new moon, quarter-moon, and full moon: set the celestial-standard intercalary day and remainder; if below the qi stride (qi ce), subtract from the qi stride to obtain entry into Major Snow (da xue) qi;

sentences.zh: 以上者去之，餘以減氣策，為入小雪氣：即天正十一月經朔入氣日及餘。

translations.literal: if above, cast it out; subtract the qi stride from the remainder again to obtain entry into Minor Snow qi: that is the day and remainder of the celestial-standard month-11 canonical new moon's qi entry.
translations.idiomatic: if above, cast it out; subtract the qi stride from the remainder again to obtain entry into Minor Snow (xiao xue) qi: that is the day and remainder of the celestial-standard month-11 canonical new moon's qi entry.

sentences.zh: 求弦、望及後朔入氣，以弦策累加之，滿氣策去之，即各得弦、望及次朔入氣日及餘。

translations.literal: To find qi entry for quarter-moon, full moon, and later new moons, add the quarter-moon stride cumulatively; cast out a full qi stride each time to obtain the day and remainder of qi entry for each quarter-moon, full moon, and successive new moon.
translations.idiomatic: To find qi entry for quarter-moon, full moon, and later new moons, add the quarter-moon stride (xian ce) cumulatively; cast out a full qi stride each time to obtain the day and remainder of qi entry for each quarter-moon, full moon, and successive new moon.

sentences.zh: 求經朔弦望入氣朏朒定數：各以所入氣小餘乘其日損益率，如日法而一，所得，以損益其日下朏朒積，各為定數。

translations.literal: To find the fixed deficit–surfeit number for canonical new moon, quarter-moon, and full moon qi entry: for each, multiply the lesser remainder of the entered qi by its daily gain-and-loss rate, divide by the day divisor, and apply the result to add or subtract the deficit–surfeit accumulation below that day—each yields a fixed number.
translations.idiomatic: To find the fixed deficit–surfeit number for canonical new moon, quarter-moon, and full moon qi entry: for each, multiply the lesser remainder of the entered qi by its daily gain-and-loss rate (sun-yi-lu), divide by the day divisor (ri fa), and apply the result to add or subtract the deficit–surfeit accumulation (fei nei ji) below that day—each yields a fixed number.

translations.literal: According to the equatorial lodge positions in various calendars, setting whole degrees directly loses the true values considerably.
translations.idiomatic: In various calendars, equatorial lodge positions were set as whole degrees, which departs significantly from true values.

sentences.zh: 今依宋朝渾儀校測距度，分定太、半、少，用為常數，校之天道，最為密近。

translations.literal: Now, relying on arc degrees calibrated with the Song armillary sphere, major, half, and minor fractions are fixed as constants; compared with the celestial Way, this is closest and most precise.
translations.idiomatic: The present calendar instead uses arc degrees measured with the Song armillary sphere, fixing major, half, and minor fractions as constants—a fit to the heavens that is closest and most precise.

sentences.zh: 如考唐，用唐所測；

translations.literal: If verifying the Tang, use what the Tang measured;
translations.idiomatic: To verify against the Tang, use Tang-era measurements;

sentences.zh: 考古，用古所測：即各得當時宿度。

translations.literal: if verifying antiquity, use what antiquity measured: each then obtains the lodge degrees of that time.
translations.idiomatic: to verify antiquity, use ancient measurements—each then yields the lodge degrees of that era.

sentences.zh: 求冬至赤道日度：以歲差乘所求積年，滿周天分去之，不滿，覆減周天分，餘如五千八百三十二而一為分，不盡，退除為秒。

translations.literal: Seek the winter solstice equatorial solar degree: multiply precession by the accumulated years sought; when full remove the circuit-of-heaven parts; if not full, subtract again from the circuit-of-heaven parts; divide the remainder by five thousand eight hundred thirty-two for minutes; what does not fill, retreat and remove for seconds.
translations.idiomatic: Procedure to find the winter solstice equatorial solar degree: multiply precession by the accumulated years sought, discard full circuit-of-heaven parts, and if a remainder remains subtract the circuit-of-heaven parts again; divide by 5,832 for minutes and convert the remainder into seconds.

sentences.zh: 其分，滿百為度，命起赤道虛宿七度外去之，至不滿宿，即所求年天正冬至加時日躔赤道宿度及分秒。

translations.literal: For the minutes, when full of one hundred make degrees; count from beyond the seventh degree of equatorial Void lodge outward and remove; until a lodge is not filled—that is the sought year’s civil new-year winter solstice hour-of-addition solar motion equatorial lodge degree and minutes and seconds.
translations.idiomatic: Carry hundreds into degrees, count from beyond Void lodge 7° on the equator and discard full lodges, and the lodge not yet filled gives the winter solstice hour-of-addition equatorial solar lodge degree and minutes and seconds for the civil new year of the year sought.

sentences.zh: 求春分、夏至、秋分赤道日度：置天正冬至加時赤道日度，累加象限，滿赤道宿次去之，即各得春分、夏至、秋分加時日在宿度及分秒。

translations.literal: Seek the spring equinox, summer solstice, and autumn equinox equatorial solar degrees: set the civil new-year winter solstice hour-of-addition equatorial solar degree, accumulate adding the image quadrant, when the equatorial lodge cycle is full remove it—then each obtain the spring equinox, summer solstice, and autumn equinox hour-of-addition solar day-in-lodge degree and minutes and seconds.
translations.idiomatic: Procedure to find the equatorial solar degrees at spring equinox, summer solstice, and autumn equinox: set the winter solstice equatorial degree at hour-of-addition, add the image quadrant repeatedly, discard full equatorial cycles, and obtain the equatorial lodge degrees and minutes and seconds at hour-of-addition for each cardinal.

sentences.zh: 求四正後赤道宿積度：置四正赤道宿全度，以四正赤道日度及分減之，餘為距後度；

translations.literal: Seek the post-cardinal equatorial lodge accumulated degrees: set each four-cardinal equatorial lodge’s full degree; subtract the four-cardinal equatorial solar degree and minutes—the remainder is the degree after the cardinal;
translations.idiomatic: Procedure to find accumulated equatorial degrees after the four cardinals: set the full width of each cardinal equatorial lodge, subtract the cardinal equatorial solar degree and minutes, and the remainder is the post-cardinal distance;

sentences.zh: 以赤道宿度累加之，各得四正後赤道宿積度及分。

translations.literal: accumulate adding equatorial lodge degrees—each obtains the post-cardinal equatorial lodge accumulated degree and minutes.
translations.idiomatic: add equatorial lodge widths cumulatively to obtain the accumulated equatorial degree and minutes after each cardinal.

sentences.zh: 求赤道宿積度入初末限：視四正後赤道宿積度及分，在四十五度六十五分、秒五十四半已下為入初限；

translations.literal: Seek entry into initial and terminal limit for equatorial lodge accumulated degree: inspect the post-cardinal equatorial lodge accumulated degree and minutes—at forty-five degrees sixty-five minutes fifty-four and a half seconds and below is entry into the initial limit;
translations.idiomatic: Procedure to find whether an equatorial accumulated degree falls in the initial or terminal limit: if the post-cardinal equatorial accumulation is 45° 65′ 54.5″ or less, it is in the initial limit;

sentences.zh: 已上，用減象限，餘為入末限。

translations.literal: above, subtract from the image quadrant—the remainder is entry into the terminal limit.
translations.idiomatic: otherwise subtract it from the image quadrant and the remainder is in the terminal limit.

sentences.zh: 求二十八宿黃道度：以四正後赤道宿入初、末限度及分，減一百一度，余以初、末限度及分乘之，進位，滿百為分，分滿百為度，至後以減、分後以加赤道宿積度，為其宿黃道積度；

translations.literal: Seek the twenty-eight lodges’ ecliptic degrees: with the post-cardinal equatorial lodge’s degrees and minutes in the initial or terminal limit, subtract from one hundred one degrees; multiply the remainder by the initial or terminal limit degrees and minutes; carry in division; when full of one hundred make minutes; when minutes are full of one hundred make degrees; after the solstice subtract, after the equinox add—to the equatorial lodge accumulated degree for its lodge ecliptic accumulated degree;
translations.idiomatic: Procedure to find the ecliptic degrees of the twenty-eight lodges: subtract the post-cardinal equatorial limit from 101°, multiply by the limit’s degrees and minutes, carry as needed, convert hundreds into minutes and then degrees, subtract after winter solstice and add after the equinoxes to convert equatorial accumulation into ecliptic accumulation for each lodge;

sentences.zh: 以前宿黃道積度減之，其四正之宿，先加象限，然後以前宿減之。

translations.literal: subtract the prior lodge’s ecliptic accumulated degree; for the four cardinals’ lodges, first add the image quadrant, then subtract the prior lodge.
translations.idiomatic: subtract the prior lodge’s ecliptic accumulation; for the four cardinal lodges, add the image quadrant first, then subtract the prior lodge.

sentences.zh: 為其宿黃道度分。

translations.literal: This is its lodge ecliptic degree and minutes.
translations.idiomatic: The result is that lodge’s ecliptic degree and minutes.

sentences.zh: 其分就近約為太、半、少。

translations.literal: Its minutes are then approximated as major, half, and minor.
translations.idiomatic: Round the minutes to major, half, and minor fractions.

translations.literal: The foregoing ecliptic lodge degrees are fixed by calculation according to the present calendar’s precession.
translations.idiomatic: The ecliptic lodge degrees above are determined by the present calendar’s precessional position.

sentences.zh: 如上考往古，下驗將來，當據歲差，每移一度，依術推變當時宿度，然後可步七曜，知其所在。

translations.literal: To verify antiquity above and test the future below, one must rely on precession: for each degree it shifts, derive by the procedure the lodge degrees of that time—only then can one step the seven luminaries and know their positions.
translations.idiomatic: To check the past and test the future, rely on precession: whenever it shifts a degree, recalculate contemporary lodge degrees by the procedure—only then can the seven luminaries be stepped and their places known.

sentences.zh: 如徑求七曜所在，置所在積度，以前黃道宿積度減之，為所在黃道宿度及分。

translations.literal: If directly seeking where the seven luminaries stand, set the accumulated degree of the place, subtract the prior ecliptic lodge accumulated degree—for the ecliptic lodge degree and minutes of the place.
translations.idiomatic: To find a luminary’s position directly, set its accumulated longitude, subtract the prior ecliptic lodge accumulation, and obtain its ecliptic lodge degree and minutes.

sentences.zh: 求天正冬至加時黃道日度：以冬至加時赤道日度及分秒，減一百一度，餘以冬至加時赤道日度及分秒乘之，進位，滿百為分，分滿百為度，命曰黃赤道差；

translations.literal: Seek the civil new-year winter solstice hour-of-addition ecliptic solar degree: with the winter solstice hour-of-addition equatorial solar degree and minutes and seconds, subtract one hundred one degrees; multiply the remainder by the winter solstice hour-of-addition equatorial solar degree and minutes and seconds; carry in division; when full of one hundred make minutes; when minutes are full of one hundred make degrees; name it the yellow–red equator difference;
translations.idiomatic: Procedure to find the ecliptic solar degree at civil new-year winter solstice hour-of-addition: subtract 101° from the winter solstice equatorial degree at hour-of-addition, multiply the remainder by that equatorial degree and its minutes and seconds, carry, convert hundreds into minutes and then degrees, and call the result the ecliptic–equator difference;

sentences.zh: 用減冬至赤道日度及分秒，即所求年天正冬至加時黃道日度及分秒。

translations.literal: subtract it from the winter solstice equatorial solar degree and minutes and seconds—that is the sought year’s civil new-year winter solstice hour-of-addition ecliptic solar degree and minutes and seconds.
translations.idiomatic: subtract that difference from the winter solstice equatorial degree at hour-of-addition to obtain the ecliptic solar degree and minutes and seconds at civil new-year winter solstice for the year sought.

sentences.zh: 求二十四氣加時黃道日度：置所求年冬至日躔黃赤道差，以次年黃赤道差減之，餘以所求氣數乘之，二十四而一，所得以加其氣中積及約分，又以其氣初日先後數先加後減之，用加冬至加時黃道日度，依宿次命之，即各得其氣加時黃道日躔宿度及分秒。

translations.literal: Seek the twenty-four qi hour-of-addition ecliptic solar degrees: set the sought year’s winter solstice solar-motion yellow–red equator difference; subtract the next year’s yellow–red equator difference; multiply the remainder by the number of qi sought and divide by twenty-four; add the result to that qi’s central accumulation and approximate parts; also add or subtract according to that qi’s first-day lead-and-lag counts, adding first and subtracting after; apply to the winter solstice hour-of-addition ecliptic solar degree; remove by lodge cycle in succession—then each obtains that qi’s hour-of-addition ecliptic solar motion lodge degree and minutes and seconds.
translations.idiomatic: Procedure to find the ecliptic solar degrees at hour-of-addition for all twenty-four qi: take the winter solstice ecliptic–equator difference for the year sought, subtract the next year’s difference, multiply the remainder by the qi number and divide by twenty-four, add to the qi’s central accumulation and approximate parts, adjust by the first-day lead-and-lag counts (add first, subtract after), add to the winter solstice ecliptic degree at hour-of-addition, and discard full lodge cycles to obtain each qi’s ecliptic solar lodge at hour-of-addition.

sentences.zh: 如其年冬至加時赤道宿度空，分秒在歲差已下者，即加前宿全度。

translations.literal: If that year’s winter solstice hour-of-addition equatorial lodge degree is empty and the minutes and seconds are below precession, add the prior lodge’s full degree.
translations.idiomatic: If the winter solstice equatorial lodge at hour-of-addition has fractional minutes and seconds below the precessional threshold, add the prior lodge’s full width.

sentences.zh: 然求黃赤道差，餘依術算。

translations.literal: Then seek the yellow–red equator difference; the remainder follows the procedure.
translations.idiomatic: Then compute the ecliptic–equator difference; otherwise follow the procedure as above.

sentences.zh: 求二十四氣晨前夜半黃道日度：置日法，以其氣小餘減之，餘副置之；

translations.literal: Seek the twenty-four qi ecliptic solar degrees before dawn and at midnight: set the day divisor; subtract that qi’s minor remainder; set the remainder aside;
translations.idiomatic: Procedure to find the ecliptic solar degrees before dawn and at midnight for each of the twenty-four qi: set the day divisor, subtract that qi’s minor remainder, and set the remainder aside;

sentences.zh: 以其氣初日盈縮分乘之，如萬約之，所得，盈加縮減其副，滿日法為度，不滿，退除為分秒，以加其氣加時黃道日度，即各得其氣一日晨前夜半黃道日度及分秒；

translations.literal: multiply by that qi’s first-day expansion–contraction parts; reduce by ten thousand; with the result, add for expansion and subtract for contraction to the subsidiary; when full of the day divisor make degrees; if not full, retreat and remove for minutes and seconds; add to that qi’s hour-of-addition ecliptic solar degree—then each obtains that qi’s first-day ecliptic solar degree before dawn and at midnight and minutes and seconds;
translations.idiomatic: multiply by that qi’s first-day expansion–contraction parts, reduce by ten thousand, add for expansion and subtract for contraction to the subsidiary, convert a full day divisor into degrees and the remainder into minutes and seconds, add to that qi’s ecliptic degree at hour-of-addition, and obtain that qi’s first-day ecliptic solar degree before dawn and at midnight with minutes and seconds;

sentences.zh: 每日加一度，以百約每日盈縮分為分秒，盈加縮減之，滿黃道宿次去之，即每日晨前夜半黃道日躔宿度及分秒。

translations.literal: each day add one degree; reduce the daily expansion–contraction parts by one hundred for minutes and seconds; add for expansion and subtract for contraction; when the ecliptic lodge cycle is full remove it—then the daily ecliptic solar motion lodge degree and minutes and seconds before dawn and at midnight.
translations.idiomatic: add one degree each day, reduce the daily expansion–contraction parts by one hundred to obtain minutes and seconds, add for expansion and subtract for contraction, discard full ecliptic cycles, and obtain the daily ecliptic solar lodge degree and minutes and seconds before dawn and at midnight.

sentences.zh: 其二十四氣初日晨前夜半黃道日度，系屬前氣，自前氣攤算，即各得所求。

translations.literal: The first-day ecliptic solar degrees before dawn and at midnight for the twenty-four qi belong to the prior qi; spread the calculation from the prior qi—then each sought value is obtained.
translations.idiomatic: Each qi’s first-day ecliptic degrees before dawn and at midnight belong to the preceding qi; spread the calculation from that prior qi to obtain each value sought.

sentences.zh: 求每日午中黃道日度：置一萬分，以所入氣日盈縮分盈加縮減而半之，滿百為分，不滿為秒，以加其日晨前夜半黃道日度，即其日午中日躔黃道宿度及分。

translations.literal: Seek the daily noon ecliptic solar degree: set ten thousand parts; with the entered qi’s daily expansion–contraction parts, add for expansion and subtract for contraction and halve; when full of one hundred make minutes; if not full make seconds; add to that day’s ecliptic solar degree before dawn and at midnight—that day’s noon solar motion ecliptic lodge degree and minutes.
translations.idiomatic: Procedure to find the daily noon ecliptic solar degree: set 10,000 parts, apply the entered qi’s daily expansion–contraction parts (add for expansion, subtract for contraction) and halve, convert hundreds to minutes and the remainder to seconds, add to that day’s ecliptic degree before dawn and at midnight, and obtain the noon ecliptic solar lodge degree and minutes.

sentences.zh: 求夏至加時黃道日度：置天正冬至加時黃道日度及分秒，以二至限及分秒加之，滿黃道宿次去之，不滿，為夏至加時黃道日度及分秒。

translations.literal: Seek the summer solstice hour-of-addition ecliptic solar degree: set the civil new-year winter solstice hour-of-addition ecliptic solar degree and minutes and seconds; add the two-solstice limit and minutes and seconds; when the ecliptic lodge cycle is full remove it; if not full, that is the summer solstice hour-of-addition ecliptic solar degree and minutes and seconds.
translations.idiomatic: Procedure to find the summer solstice ecliptic solar degree at hour-of-addition: set the winter solstice ecliptic degree at hour-of-addition with minutes and seconds, add the two-solstice limit with minutes and seconds, discard full ecliptic cycles, and the remainder is the summer solstice ecliptic degree at hour-of-addition with minutes and seconds.

sentences.zh: 求每日午中黃道積度：以二至加時黃道日度距至所求日午中黃道日度，為入二至後黃道積度及分。

translations.literal: Seek the daily noon accumulated ecliptic degree: from the two-solstice hour-of-addition ecliptic solar degree to the sought day’s noon ecliptic solar degree is the accumulated ecliptic degree after entering the two solstices and minutes.
translations.idiomatic: Procedure to find the daily noon accumulated ecliptic degree: measure from the solstice ecliptic degree at hour-of-addition to the sought day’s noon ecliptic degree to obtain the accumulated ecliptic degree after the solstice with minutes.

sentences.zh: 求每日午中黃道入初末限：視二至後黃道積度，在四十三度一十二分、秒八十七以下為初限；

translations.literal: Seek daily noon ecliptic entry into initial and terminal limits: inspect the accumulated ecliptic degree after the two solstices—at forty-three degrees twelve minutes eighty-seven seconds and below is the initial limit;
translations.idiomatic: Procedure to find daily noon ecliptic entry into initial and terminal limits: for accumulated ecliptic degree after a solstice, 43° 12′ 87″ or below is the initial limit;

sentences.zh: 以上，用減象限，餘為入末限。

translations.literal: above, subtract from the image quadrant—the remainder is entry into the terminal limit.
translations.idiomatic: above that, subtract the image quadrant and the remainder is in the terminal limit.

sentences.zh: 其積度滿象限去之，為二分後黃道積度，在四十八度一十八分、秒二十二以下為初限；

translations.literal: When the accumulated degree fills the image quadrant remove it—that is the accumulated ecliptic degree after the equinox; at forty-eight degrees eighteen minutes twenty-two seconds and below is the initial limit;
translations.idiomatic: when the accumulation fills the image quadrant, discard it to obtain the post-equinox accumulated ecliptic degree; 48° 18′ 22″ or below is the initial limit;

sentences.zh: 以上，用減象限，餘為入末限。

translations.literal: above, subtract from the image quadrant—the remainder is entry into the terminal limit.
translations.idiomatic: above that, subtract the image quadrant and the remainder is in the terminal limit.

sentences.zh: 求每日午中赤道日度：以所求日午中黃道積度，入至後初限、分後末限度及分秒，進三位，加二十萬二千五十少，開平方除之，所得，減去四百四十九半，余在初限者，直以二至赤道日度加而命之；

translations.literal: Seek the daily noon equatorial solar degree: with the sought day’s noon accumulated ecliptic degree, entering after the solstice the initial limit and after the equinox the terminal limit, with degrees and minutes and seconds, advance three places, add two hundred two thousand fifty and a fraction less, extract the square root and divide by it; subtract four hundred forty-nine and a half from the result; if in the initial limit, directly add the two-solstice equatorial solar degree and assign the lodges;
translations.idiomatic: Procedure to find the daily noon equatorial solar degree: take the sought day’s noon accumulated ecliptic degree—after a solstice in the initial limit, after an equinox in the terminal limit—with degrees, minutes, and seconds; advance three places, add 202,050 and a fraction less, take the square root and divide; subtract 449.5; if in the initial limit, add the two-solstice equatorial solar degree directly and assign the lodges;

sentences.zh: 在末限者，以減象限，餘以二分赤道日度加而命之：即每日午中赤道日度。

translations.literal: if in the terminal limit, subtract the image quadrant; with the remainder add the two-equinox equatorial solar degree and assign the lodges: that is the daily noon equatorial solar degree.
translations.idiomatic: if in the terminal limit, subtract the image quadrant, add the two-equinox equatorial solar degree to the remainder, and assign the lodges: that yields the daily noon equatorial solar degree.

sentences.zh: 以所求日午中黃道積度，入至後末限、分後初限度及分秒，進三位，用減三十萬三千五十少，開平方除之，所得，以減五百五十半，余在初限者，直以二分赤道日度加而命之；

translations.literal: With the sought day’s noon accumulated ecliptic degree, entering after the solstice the terminal limit and after the equinox the initial limit, with degrees and minutes and seconds, advance three places, subtract three hundred three thousand fifty and a fraction less, extract the square root and divide by it; subtract five hundred fifty and a half from the result; if in the initial limit, directly add the two-equinox equatorial solar degree and assign the lodges;
translations.idiomatic: Take the sought day’s noon accumulated ecliptic degree—after a solstice in the terminal limit, after an equinox in the initial limit—with degrees, minutes, and seconds; advance three places, subtract 303,050 and a fraction less, take the square root and divide; subtract 550.5; if in the initial limit, add the two-equinox equatorial solar degree directly and assign the lodges;

sentences.zh: 在末限者，以減象限，餘以二至赤道日度加而命之：即每日午中赤道日度。

translations.literal: if in the terminal limit, subtract the image quadrant; with the remainder add the two-solstice equatorial solar degree and assign the lodges: that is the daily noon equatorial solar degree.
translations.idiomatic: if in the terminal limit, subtract the image quadrant, add the two-solstice equatorial solar degree to the remainder, and assign the lodges: that yields the daily noon equatorial solar degree.

sentences.zh: 求太陽入宮日時刻及分：各置入宮宿度及分秒，以其日晨前夜半日度減之，餘以二十四乘，為時實；

translations.literal: Seek the day, hour, quarter, and minutes of the sun’s entry into a palace: for each, set the palace-entry lodge degree and minutes and seconds; subtract that day’s ecliptic solar degree before dawn and at midnight; multiply the remainder by twenty-four for the hour dividend;
translations.idiomatic: Procedure to find the day, hour, quarter, and minutes of solar palace entry: set each palace-entry lodge degree with minutes and seconds, subtract that day’s ecliptic solar degree before dawn and at midnight, and multiply the remainder by twenty-four for the hour dividend;

sentences.zh: 以其日太陽行度及分秒為法實，如法而一，為半時數；

translations.literal: with that day’s solar motion degree and minutes and seconds as the divisor dividend, divide by the divisor for the half-hour count;
translations.idiomatic: take that day’s solar motion degree with minutes and seconds as the divisor dividend, divide by the divisor for the half-hour count;

sentences.zh: 不滿，進二位，為刻實；

translations.literal: What does not fill, carry two places, for the quarter dividend;
translations.idiomatic: If it does not fill, shift two places for the quarter dividend;

sentences.zh: 以二十四乘，前法除之為刻，不滿，退除為分。

translations.literal: Multiply by twenty-four; divide by the previous method for quarters; what does not fill, step back and divide for minutes.
translations.idiomatic: Multiply by 24 and divide by the previous divisor for quarters; the remainder, stepped back, gives minutes.

sentences.zh: 其半時命起子正，算外，即得太陽入宮初正時、刻及分。

translations.literal: For half the double-hour count, name from zi zheng, outside the count: thereby obtain the Sun's entering-palace initial correct time, quarter, and minutes.
translations.idiomatic: At half the double-hour count, count from zi zheng (outside the count) to obtain the exact time, quarter, and minutes when the Sun enters the palace.

sentences.zh: 其逐刻日、時及分，舊曆均其日數，從其簡略，未盡其詳。

translations.literal: As for the quarter-by-quarter day, time, and minutes, the old calendar averaged the day-counts—following convenience but not exhaustively detailed.
translations.idiomatic: For day, time, and minute at each quarter, the old calendar averaged day-counts—a simplified treatment that did not fully elaborate the procedure.

sentences.zh: 今但依入宮正術求之，即允協天道。

translations.literal: Now we only seek it by the entering-palace correct procedure: thereby it agrees with the Heavenly Way.
translations.idiomatic: We now derive it solely by the correct palace-entry method, which aligns with celestial principles.

sentences.zh: 步晷漏

translations.literal: Stepping Gnomon and Clepsydra.
translations.idiomatic: Stepping Gnomon and Clepsydra.

sentences.zh: 二至限：一百八十二、分六十二、秒一十八。

translations.literal: Solstice limit: 182, minutes 62, seconds 18.
translations.idiomatic: Solstice limit (er zhi xian): 182°, 62′, 18″.

sentences.zh: 象限：九十一、分二十一、秒九。

translations.literal: Quadrant limit: 91, minutes 21, seconds 9.
translations.idiomatic: Quadrant limit (xiang xian): 91°, 21′, 9″.

sentences.zh: 一象度：九十一、分二十一、秒四十三。

translations.literal: One-quadrant degrees: 91, minutes 21, seconds 43.
translations.idiomatic: One-quadrant arc: 91°, 21′, 43″.

sentences.zh: 冬至後初限夏至後末限：六十二日、分二十。

translations.literal: Initial limit after winter solstice and final limit after summer solstice: 62 days, minutes 20.
translations.idiomatic: Initial limit after winter solstice and final limit after summer solstice: 62 days, 20′.

sentences.zh: 夏至後初限冬至後末限：一百二十日、分四十二。

translations.literal: Initial limit after summer solstice and final limit after winter solstice: 120 days, minutes 42.
translations.idiomatic: Initial limit after summer solstice and final limit after winter solstice: 120 days, 42′.

sentences.zh: 已上分秒母各同一百。

translations.literal: For the above, the minute and second divisors are each uniformly 100.
translations.idiomatic: For the above values, minutes and seconds share the divisor 100.

sentences.zh: 冬至嶽台晷影常數：一丈二尺八寸三分。

translations.literal: Yuetai gnomon shadow constant for winter solstice: 1 zhang 2 chi 8 cun 3 fen.
translations.idiomatic: Standard Yuetai noon gnomon shadow at winter solstice: 1 zhang 2 chi 8 cun 3 fen.

sentences.zh: 夏至嶽台晷影常數：一尺五寸六分。

translations.literal: Yuetai gnomon shadow constant for summer solstice: 1 chi 5 cun 6 fen.
translations.idiomatic: Standard Yuetai noon gnomon shadow at summer solstice: 1 chi 5 cun 6 fen.

sentences.zh: 昏明分：一百八十二少。

translations.literal: Twilight parts: 182 and a small deficiency.
translations.idiomatic: Twilight parts: 182 shao (182 and a fractional shortfall).

sentences.zh: 昏明刻：二分三百六十四半。

translations.literal: Twilight quarters: 2 quarters, 364 and a half.
translations.idiomatic: Twilight quarters: 2 ke, 364.5 fen.

sentences.zh: 辰刻：八分二百四十三。

translations.literal: Double-hour quarters: 8 quarters, 243.
translations.idiomatic: Double-hour quarters: 8 ke, 243 fen.

sentences.zh: 半辰刻：四分一百二十一半。

translations.literal: Half double-hour quarters: 4 quarters, 121 and a half.
translations.idiomatic: Half double-hour quarters: 4 ke, 121.5 fen.

sentences.zh: 刻法：七百二十九。

translations.literal: Quarter divisor: 729.
translations.idiomatic: Quarter divisor (ke fa): 729.

sentences.zh: 求午中入氣：置所求日大餘及半法，以所入氣大、小餘減之，為其日午中入氣日及餘。

translations.literal: To find midday entry into a qi: set the sought day's greater remainder and half divisor; subtract the entered qi's greater and lesser remainders: that is the day's midday entry into the qi—days and remainder.
translations.idiomatic: To find midday solar-term entry: take the sought day's greater remainder plus the half divisor, subtract the entered qi's greater and lesser remainders—this gives the day's midday entry into the qi in days and remainder.

sentences.zh: 求午中中積：置其氣中積，以午中入氣日及余加之，其餘以日法退除為分秒。

translations.literal: To find midday mid-term accumulation: set that qi's mid-term accumulation; add the midday entry days and remainder; for the remainder, step back divide by the day divisor for minutes and seconds.
translations.idiomatic: To find the midday mid-term accumulation: start from the qi's mid-term accumulation, add midday entry days and remainder, then convert excess remainder through the day divisor into minutes and seconds.

sentences.zh: 為所求日午中中積及分秒。

translations.literal: This is the sought day's midday mid-term accumulation and minutes-seconds.
translations.idiomatic: The result is the sought day's midday mid-term accumulation in days, minutes, and seconds.

sentences.zh: 求午中入二至後初末限；

translations.literal: To find midday entry into initial or final limit after the solstices;
translations.idiomatic: To find midday entry into the solstice initial or final limit:

sentences.zh: 置午中中積及分，為入冬至後；

translations.literal: Set the midday mid-term accumulation and minutes; this is entry after winter solstice;
translations.idiomatic: Take the midday mid-term accumulation and minutes as entry after winter solstice;

sentences.zh: 滿二至限去之，為入夏至後。

translations.literal: When full of the solstice limit, remove it; this is entry after summer solstice.
translations.idiomatic: When it exceeds the solstice limit, subtract that limit to obtain entry after summer solstice.

sentences.zh: 其二至後，如在初限已下為入初限；

translations.literal: For the two post-solstice periods: if within the initial limit or below, it is entry into the initial limit;
translations.idiomatic: Within each post-solstice interval: if at or below the initial limit, count as initial-limit entry;

sentences.zh: 已上，覆減二至限，餘為入末限。

translations.literal: If at or above, invert subtract the solstice limit; the remainder is entry into the final limit.
translations.idiomatic: If at or above that threshold, subtract the solstice limit from it; the remainder is final-limit entry.

sentences.zh: 求嶽台晷影午中定數：冬至後初限、夏至後末限，以百通日，內分，自相乘為實，置之；

translations.literal: To find the fixed Yuetai gnomon shadow at midday: for initial limit after winter solstice and final limit after summer solstice, convert days to hundreds and include minutes internally, multiply by itself for dividend and set aside;
translations.idiomatic: To find the fixed Yuetai noon gnomon shadow: in the winter-solstice initial / summer-solstice final interval, express days in hundredths including minutes, square the value for the dividend;

sentences.zh: 以七百二十五除之，所得，加一十萬六百一十七，併入限分，折半為法，實如法而一為分，不滿，退除為小分，其分滿十為寸，寸滿十為尺，用減冬至嶽台晷影常數，即得所求午中晷影定數。

translations.literal: Divide by 725; to the quotient add 100,617; combine with limit minutes, halve for divisor; dividend divided by divisor gives minutes—what does not fill, step back for small minutes; when minutes fill ten they become cun, when cun fill ten they become chi; subtract from the winter solstice Yuetai gnomon shadow constant: thereby obtain the sought midday gnomon shadow fixed number.
translations.idiomatic: Divide by 725; add the quotient to 100,617, combine with limit minutes and halve for the divisor; divide the dividend by the divisor for minutes (remainder stepped back for fractional minutes); convert ten minutes to one cun and ten cun to one chi; subtract from the standard winter-solstice Yuetai shadow—the result is the fixed noon gnomon shadow sought.

sentences.zh: 夏至後初限、冬至後末限，以百通日，內分，自相乘，為實，乃置入限分，九因，再折，加一十九萬八千七十五為法，其夏至前後，日如在半限以上者，減去半限，餘置於上，列半限於下，以上減下，餘以乘上，進二位，七十七除之，所得加法為定法，然後除之。

translations.literal: For initial limit after summer solstice and final limit after winter solstice: convert days to hundreds and include minutes internally, multiply by itself for dividend; then set limit minutes, multiply by nine, halve twice, add 198,075 for divisor; for summer solstice before and after, if the day is at or above half the limit, subtract half the limit and set the remainder above with half the limit below; subtract below from above and multiply the remainder by the above, carry two places, divide by 77 for quotient and add to divisor for fixed divisor—then divide.
translations.idiomatic: In the summer-solstice initial / winter-solstice final interval: express days in hundredths including minutes and square for the dividend; set limit minutes, multiply by 9, halve twice, add 198,075 as divisor; if the day lies at or beyond half the limit around summer solstice, subtract half the limit, place remainder over half-limit below, subtract and multiply; carry two places, divide by 77, add quotient to divisor for the fixed divisor—then perform the division.

sentences.zh: 實如法而一為分，不滿，退除為小分，其分滿十為寸，寸滿十為尺，以加夏至嶽台晷影常數，即得所求日午中晷影定數。

translations.literal: Dividend divided by divisor gives minutes; what does not fill, step back for small minutes; when minutes fill ten they become cun, when cun fill ten they become chi; add to the summer solstice Yuetai gnomon shadow constant: thereby obtain the sought day's midday gnomon shadow fixed number.
translations.idiomatic: Divide dividend by divisor for minutes (remainder stepped back for fractional minutes); convert by tens to cun and chi; add to the standard summer-solstice Yuetai shadow—the result is that day's fixed noon gnomon shadow.

sentences.zh: 求每日日行積度：以午中入氣餘乘其日盈縮分，日法而一，冬至後盈加縮減、夏至後縮加盈減先後數，以先加後減中積日及分秒，滿與不足，進退其日，為所求日行積度及分秒。

translations.literal: To find daily accumulated solar motion degrees: multiply the midday qi-entry remainder by that day's surplus-deficit parts; divide by day divisor; after winter solstice add surplus and subtract deficit, after summer solstice add deficit and subtract surplus from the advance-retard numbers; to the prior mid-term accumulation of days and minutes-seconds, add first and subtract later—when full or insufficient, advance or retreat the day—for the sought day's accumulated daily solar motion degrees and minutes-seconds.
translations.idiomatic: To find daily accumulated solar motion: multiply midday qi-entry remainder by the day's surplus-deficit part and divide by the day divisor; after winter solstice add surplus and subtract deficit, after summer solstice the reverse; apply advance-retard to the mid-term day accumulation (add early, subtract late), adjusting days as needed—the result is accumulated daily solar motion in degrees, minutes, and seconds.

sentences.zh: 求每日赤道內外度：置所求日午中日行積度及分，如不滿二至限，在象限已下為冬至後度；

translations.literal: To find daily equatorial north-south degrees: set the sought day's midday accumulated daily solar degrees and minutes; if not full of the solstice limit and below the quadrant limit, it is degrees after winter solstice;
translations.idiomatic: To find daily equatorial declination: take the day's midday accumulated solar degrees and minutes; if below the solstice limit and under the quadrant limit, count as post–winter-solstice degrees;

sentences.zh: 象限已上，用減二至限，為夏至前度。

translations.literal: If at or above the quadrant limit, subtract from the solstice limit: degrees before summer solstice.
translations.idiomatic: If at or above the quadrant limit, subtract from the solstice limit for pre–summer-solstice degrees.

sentences.zh: 如滿二至限去之，餘在象限以下為夏至後度；

translations.literal: If full of the solstice limit, remove it; if the remainder is below the quadrant limit, it is degrees after summer solstice;
translations.idiomatic: If it exceeds the solstice limit, subtract that limit; if the remainder is below the quadrant limit, count as post–summer-solstice degrees;

sentences.zh: 象限以上，用減二至限，為冬至前度。

translations.literal: If at or above the quadrant limit, subtract from the solstice limit: degrees before winter solstice.
translations.idiomatic: If at or above the quadrant limit, subtract from the solstice limit for pre–winter-solstice degrees.

sentences.zh: 並置之於上，列象限於下，以上減下，餘以乘上，冬至前後五百一十七而一，夏至前後四百而一為度，不滿，退除為分，以加二至前後度，所得，用減象限，餘置於上，列二至限於下，以上減下，餘以乘上，其度、分、秒皆以百通，然後乘之。

translations.literal: In each case set the above and list the quadrant limit below; subtract below from above; multiply the remainder by the above; before winter solstice divide by 517, before summer solstice divide by 400 for degrees—what does not fill, step back for minutes; add to degrees before and after the solstice; take the result and subtract from the quadrant limit; set remainder above and solstice limit below; subtract below from above; multiply remainder by above; convert degrees, minutes, and seconds each by hundreds before multiplying.
translations.idiomatic: Place the computed value over the quadrant limit below, subtract and multiply; divide by 517 before winter solstice or 400 before summer solstice for degrees (remainder stepped back for minutes); add to pre-solstice degrees; subtract from the quadrant limit, repeat the subtract-multiply with the solstice limit below, converting degrees, minutes, and seconds to hundredths before multiplication.

sentences.zh: 退一位，如三十四萬八千八百五十六而一為秒，滿百為分，分滿百為度，即所求日黃道去赤道內外度及分。

translations.literal: Step back one place; divide by 348,856 for seconds; when full of 100 they become minutes, when minutes full of 100 they become degrees: thereby the sought day's ecliptic north-south distance from the equator in degrees and minutes.
translations.idiomatic: Shift one place and divide by 348,856 for seconds; 100 seconds make one minute, 100 minutes one degree—the result is the day's ecliptic declination in degrees and minutes.

sentences.zh: 冬至前後為外，夏至前後為內。

translations.literal: Before and after winter solstice is outer; before and after summer solstice is inner.
translations.idiomatic: South of the equator before and after winter solstice; north of the equator before and after summer solstice.

sentences.zh: 求每日午中太陽去極度；

translations.literal: To find daily midday solar polar distance;
translations.idiomatic: To find daily midday solar polar distance:

sentences.zh: 以每日午中黃道去赤道內、外度及分，內減外加一象度及分，為每日午中太陽去極度及分。

translations.literal: Take the daily midday ecliptic north-south distance from the equator in degrees and minutes; subtract if inner and add if outer one quadrant of degrees and minutes: this is the daily midday solar polar distance in degrees and minutes.
translations.idiomatic: From the day's midday ecliptic declination, subtract if north of the equator or add if south, plus one quadrant arc—the result is midday solar polar distance.

sentences.zh: 求每日日出入分晨昏分半晝分：置所求日黃道去赤道內外度及分，以三百六十三乘之，進一位，如二百三十九而一，所得，以加減一千八百二十二半，赤道內以減，赤道外以加。

translations.literal: To find daily sunrise/sunset parts, dawn/dusk parts, and half-day parts: set the sought day's ecliptic north-south distance from equator in degrees and minutes; multiply by 363; carry one place; divide by 239 for the quotient; add or subtract from 1,822.5—subtract if equator-inner, add if equator-outer.
translations.idiomatic: To find sunrise, sunset, dawn, dusk, and half-day parts: take the day's ecliptic declination, multiply by 363, shift one place, divide by 239; from 1,822.5 subtract if north of the equator or add if south.

sentences.zh: 為所求日日出分；

translations.literal: This is the sought day's sunrise parts;
translations.idiomatic: This gives the day's sunrise parts;

sentences.zh: 用減日法，為日入分。

translations.literal: Subtract from the day divisor: sunset parts.
translations.idiomatic: Subtract from the day divisor for sunset parts.

sentences.zh: 以昏明分減日出分，為晨分；

translations.literal: Subtract sunrise parts from twilight parts: dawn parts;
translations.idiomatic: Twilight parts minus sunrise parts give dawn parts;

sentences.zh: 加日入分，為昏分；

translations.literal: Add sunset parts: dusk parts;
translations.idiomatic: Add sunset parts for dusk parts;

sentences.zh: 以日出分減半法，為半晝分。

translations.literal: Subtract sunrise parts from half divisor: half-day parts.
translations.idiomatic: Half divisor minus sunrise parts gives half-day parts.

sentences.zh: 求每日晝夜刻日出入辰刻：置日出分，倍之，進一位，滿刻法為刻，不滿為分，即所求日夜刻；

translations.literal: To find daily day/night quarters and sunrise/sunset double-hour quarters: set sunrise parts; double it; carry one place; when full of quarter divisor it makes quarters, what does not fill is minutes: thereby the sought day's night quarters;
translations.idiomatic: To find day/night quarters and sunrise/sunset double-hour quarters: double sunrise parts, shift one place; divide by the quarter divisor for night quarters (remainder = minutes);

sentences.zh: 以減百刻，餘為晝刻；

translations.literal: Subtract from 100 quarters: day quarters;
translations.idiomatic: Subtract from 100 quarters for day quarters;

sentences.zh: 半夜刻，滿辰刻為辰數；

translations.literal: Half the night quarters; when full of double-hour quarters it makes double-hour count;
translations.idiomatic: Halve night quarters; divide by double-hour quarters for the double-hour count;

sentences.zh: 命子正，算外，即日出辰刻；

translations.literal: Name from zi zheng, outside the count: sunrise double-hour quarters;
translations.idiomatic: Count from zi zheng (outside the count) for sunrise double-hour and quarters;

sentences.zh: 以半辰刻加之，即命起時初。

translations.literal: Add half double-hour quarters: thereby name from hour beginning.
translations.idiomatic: Add half double-hour quarters to name from the start of the double-hour.

sentences.zh: 以晝刻加之，滿辰刻為辰數；

translations.literal: Add day quarters; when full of double-hour quarters it makes double-hour count;
translations.idiomatic: Add day quarters; divide by double-hour quarters for the count;

sentences.zh: 命日出，算外，即日入辰刻及分。

translations.literal: Name from sunrise, outside the count: sunset double-hour quarters and minutes.
translations.idiomatic: Count from sunrise (outside the count) for sunset double-hour and quarters.

sentences.zh: 求每更點差刻及逐更點辰刻：置夜刻，減去十五刻，五而一，為更差；

translations.literal: To find each watch and mark difference quarters and watch-by-watch double-hour quarters: set night quarters; subtract 15 quarters; divide by five for watch difference;
translations.idiomatic: To find watch and clepsydra-mark differential quarters: take night quarters, subtract 15, divide by 5 for watch difference;

sentences.zh: 又五而一，為點差。

translations.literal: Again divide by five: mark difference.
translations.idiomatic: Divide by 5 again for mark difference.

sentences.zh: 以昏明刻加日入辰刻，即初更辰刻；

translations.literal: Add twilight quarters to sunset double-hour quarters: first watch double-hour quarters;
translations.idiomatic: Add twilight quarters to sunset double-hour quarters for the first watch;

sentences.zh: 以更點差刻累加之，滿辰刻及分去之，各得更點所入辰刻及分。

translations.literal: Accumulate add watch and mark difference quarters; when full of double-hour quarters and minutes, remove: each thereby obtains the double-hour quarters and minutes entered for each watch and mark.
translations.idiomatic: Accumulate watch and mark differentials; reduce by full double-hour quarters and minutes at each step to obtain double-hour and quarter for each watch and mark.

sentences.zh: 求每日距中度及每更差度：置所求日黃道去赤道內、外度及分，以四千四百三十五乘之，如五千八百一十二而一為度，不滿，退除為分，以內加外減一百度七十二分、秒七為距中度。

translations.literal: To find daily distance to culmination and watch difference degrees: set the sought day's ecliptic north-south distance from equator in degrees and minutes; multiply by 4,435; divide by 5,812 for degrees—what does not fill, step back for minutes; inner add and outer subtract from 100 degrees 72 minutes 7 seconds for distance to culmination.
translations.idiomatic: To find daily culmination distance and per-watch differential degrees: multiply ecliptic declination by 4,435 and divide by 5,812 for degrees (remainder stepped back for minutes); add if north of the equator or subtract if south from 100° 72′ 7″ for culmination distance.

sentences.zh: 用減一百六十四度八十一分、秒五十七，餘四因，退一位，為每更差度。

translations.literal: Subtract from 164 degrees 81 minutes 57.5 seconds; multiply remainder by four; step back one place: per-watch difference degrees.
translations.idiomatic: Subtract from 164° 81′ 57.5″; multiply the remainder by 4 and shift one place for per-watch difference degrees.

sentences.zh: 求昏曉五更及攢點中星：置距中度，以其日午中赤道日度加而命之，即昏中星所格宿次，命為初更中星；

translations.literal: To find dusk and dawn five watches and culminating stars at marks: set distance to culmination; add the day's midday equatorial solar degrees and name it: thereby the lodge of the star culminating at dusk; name this as the first watch culminating star;
translations.idiomatic: To find culminating stars at dusk, dawn, five watches, and clepsydra marks: add culmination distance to the day's midday equatorial solar longitude and name the lodge—the star culminating at dusk; this is the first watch culmination star;

sentences.zh: 以每更差度加而命之，即二更中星；

translations.literal: Add per-watch difference degrees and name: second watch culminating star;
translations.idiomatic: Add per-watch difference and name the lodge for the second watch culmination star;

sentences.zh: 以每更差度累加之，滿赤道宿度去之，即逐更及攢點中星；

translations.literal: Accumulate add per-watch difference degrees; when full of equatorial lodge degrees, remove: thereby each watch and mark culminating stars;
translations.idiomatic: Accumulate per-watch differences, reducing by full equatorial lodge arcs at each step for each watch and mark culmination;

sentences.zh: 加三十六度六十二分、秒五十七，滿赤道宿度去之，即曉中星。

translations.literal: Add 36 degrees 62 minutes 57.5 seconds; when full of equatorial lodge degrees, remove: dawn culminating star.
translations.idiomatic: Add 36° 62′ 57.5″ and reduce by lodge arcs for the dawn culmination star.

sentences.zh: 求九服晷景：各于所在測冬夏二至晷數，乃相減之，餘為二至差數。

translations.literal: To find gnomon shadows in the nine domains: at each location measure winter and summer solstice gnomon numbers; subtract them; the remainder is the solstice difference number.
translations.idiomatic: To find gnomon shadows across the nine domains: at each site measure solstice shadows, subtract, and take the remainder as the solstice differential.

sentences.zh: 如地在岳台南測夏至晷景在表南者，並冬夏二至晷數為二至差數。

translations.literal: If at a place south of Yuetai the summer solstice gnomon shadow falls south of the gnomon, add winter and summer solstice gnomon numbers for the solstice difference number.
translations.idiomatic: Where a site south of Yuetai shows the summer-solstice shadow south of the gnomon, add the two solstice shadows to get the solstice differential.

sentences.zh: 其所求日在冬至後初限、夏至後末限者，置嶽台冬至晷景常數，以所求日嶽台午中晷景定數減之，餘以其處二至差數乘之，如嶽台二至差數一丈一尺二寸七分而一，所得，以減其處冬至晷數，即其地其日中晷定數。

translations.literal: If the sought day is in initial limit after winter solstice and final limit after summer solstice: set Yuetai winter solstice gnomon shadow constant; subtract the sought day's Yuetai midday gnomon shadow fixed number; multiply remainder by that place's solstice difference number; divide by Yuetai solstice difference 1 zhang 1 chi 2 cun 7 fen; subtract quotient from that place's winter solstice gnomon number: thereby that place's that day midday gnomon fixed number.
translations.idiomatic: In the winter-solstice initial / summer-solstice final interval: take the standard Yuetai winter-solstice shadow, subtract that day's fixed Yuetai noon shadow, multiply by the local solstice differential, divide by Yuetai's differential (1 zhang 1 chi 2 cun 7 fen), and subtract from the local winter-solstice shadow for that site's fixed noon shadow.

sentences.zh: 所求日在夏至後初限、冬至後末限者，置所求日嶽台午中晷景定數，以嶽台夏至晷景常數減之，餘以其處二至差數乘之，如嶽台二至差數而一，所得，以加其處夏至晷數，即其地其日中晷定數。

translations.literal: If the sought day is in initial limit after summer solstice and final limit after winter solstice: set the sought day's Yuetai midday gnomon shadow fixed number; subtract Yuetai summer solstice gnomon shadow constant; multiply remainder by that place's solstice difference number; divide by Yuetai solstice difference number; add quotient to that place's summer solstice gnomon number: thereby that place's that day midday gnomon fixed number.
translations.idiomatic: In the summer-solstice initial / winter-solstice final interval: take the day's fixed Yuetai noon shadow, subtract the standard summer-solstice shadow, scale by local solstice differential over Yuetai's differential, and add to the local summer-solstice shadow.

sentences.zh: 如其處夏至景在表南者，以所得之數減其處夏至晷數，餘為其地其日中晷定數，亦在表南也。

translations.literal: If at that place the summer solstice shadow falls south of the gnomon, subtract the quotient from that place's summer solstice gnomon number; the remainder is that place's that day midday gnomon fixed number, also south of the gnomon.
translations.idiomatic: If the local summer shadow falls south of the gnomon, subtract the quotient from the local summer-solstice shadow—the remainder is the fixed noon shadow, likewise south of the gnomon.

sentences.zh: 其所得之數多於其處夏至晷數，即減去夏至晷數，餘為其地其日中晷定數，在表北也。

translations.literal: If the quotient exceeds that place's summer solstice gnomon number, subtract summer solstice gnomon number; the remainder is that place's that day midday gnomon fixed number, north of the gnomon.
translations.idiomatic: If the quotient exceeds the local summer-solstice shadow, subtract that shadow from the quotient—the remainder is the fixed noon shadow north of the gnomon.

sentences.zh: 求九服所在晝夜漏刻：各於所在下水漏，以定其處冬夏二至夜刻，但得一至可矣，不必須要冬夏二至。

translations.literal: To find day/night clepsydra quarters in the nine domains: at each place deploy a water clepsydra to fix that place's winter and summer solstice night quarters—obtaining one solstice suffices; both winter and summer solstices are not strictly required.
translations.idiomatic: To find day/night clepsydra quarters by region: set a clepsydra at each site and measure solstice night quarters—one solstice measurement suffices; both are not mandatory.

sentences.zh: 乃與五十刻相減，餘為至差刻。

translations.literal: Subtract from 50 quarters; the remainder is solstice difference quarters.
translations.idiomatic: Subtract from 50 quarters; the remainder is the solstice differential in quarters.

sentences.zh: 置所求日黃道去赤道內外度及分，以至差刻乘之，進一位，如二百三十九而一為刻，不盡，以刻法乘之，復八而一為分，內減外加五十刻，即所求日夜刻；

translations.literal: Set the sought day's ecliptic north-south distance from equator in degrees and minutes; multiply by solstice difference quarters; carry one place; divide by 239 for quarters—what is not exhausted, multiply by quarter divisor and again divide by eight for minutes; inner subtract and outer add 50 quarters: thereby the sought day's night quarters;
translations.idiomatic: Multiply the day's ecliptic declination by solstice differential quarters, shift one place, divide by 239 for quarters (convert remainder via the quarter divisor and divide by 8 for minutes); subtract if north of the equator or add if south from 50 quarters for night quarters;

sentences.zh: 減百刻，餘為晝刻。

translations.literal: Subtract from 100 quarters: day quarters.
translations.idiomatic: Subtract from 100 quarters for day quarters.

sentences.zh: 其日日出入辰刻及更點差刻、每更點辰刻，並依嶽台術求之。

translations.literal: For each day's sunrise/sunset double-hour quarters and watch/mark difference quarters and each watch/mark double-hour quarters, all follow the Yuetai procedure.
translations.idiomatic: Sunrise/sunset quarters, watch and mark differentials, and per-watch quarters at each site all follow the Yuetai method.

sentences.zh: 步月離

translations.literal: Stepping Lunar Motion.
translations.idiomatic: Stepping Lunar Motion.

sentences.zh: 轉周分：二十萬八百七十三、秒九百九十。

translations.literal: Rotation circuit parts: 200,873, seconds 990.
translations.idiomatic: Rotation circuit parts (zhuan zhou fen): 200,873, seconds 990.

sentences.zh: 轉周日：二十七、餘四千四十三、秒九百九十。

translations.literal: Rotation circuit days: 27, remainder 4,043, seconds 990.
translations.idiomatic: Rotation circuit days: 27 days, remainder 4,043, seconds 990.

sentences.zh: 朔差日：一、餘七千一百一十四、秒九千一十。

translations.literal: New-moon difference days: 1, remainder 7,114, seconds 9,010.
translations.idiomatic: New-moon difference days: 1 day, remainder 7,114, seconds 9,010.

sentences.zh: 望策：一十四、餘五千五百七十九。

translations.literal: Full-moon stride: 14, remainder 5,579.
translations.idiomatic: Full-moon stride (wang ce): 14, remainder 5,579.

sentences.zh: 弦策：七、餘二千七百八十九半。

translations.literal: Quadrature stride: 7, remainder 2,789.5.
translations.idiomatic: Quadrature stride (xian ce): 7, remainder 2,789.5.

sentences.zh: 已上秒母一萬。

translations.literal: For the above, the second divisor is 10,000.
translations.idiomatic: For the above values, the second divisor is 10,000.

sentences.zh: 七日：初數六千四百七十八，初約分八十九；

translations.literal: Seven days: initial number 6,478, initial approximate minutes 89;
translations.idiomatic: Seven days: initial number 6,478, initial approximate minutes 89;

sentences.zh: 末數八百一十二，末約分一十一。

translations.literal: final number 812, final approximate minutes 11.
translations.idiomatic: final number 812, final approximate minutes 11.

sentences.zh: 十四日：初數五千六百六十六，初約分七十八；

translations.literal: Fourteen days: initial number 5,666, initial approximate minutes 78;
translations.idiomatic: Fourteen days: initial number 5,666, initial approximate minutes 78;

sentences.zh: 末數一千六百二十四，末約分二十二。

translations.literal: final number 1,624, final approximate minutes 22.
translations.idiomatic: final number 1,624, final approximate minutes 22.

sentences.zh: 二十一日：初數四千八百五十四，初約分六十七；

translations.literal: Twenty-one days: initial number 4,854, initial approximate minutes 67;
translations.idiomatic: Twenty-one days: initial number 4,854, initial approximate minutes 67;

sentences.zh: 末數二千四百三十六，末約分三十三。

translations.literal: final number 2,436, final approximate minutes 33.
translations.idiomatic: final number 2,436, final approximate minutes 33.

sentences.zh: 二十八日：初數四千四十三，初約分五十五。

translations.literal: Twenty-eight days: initial number 4,043, initial approximate minutes 55.
translations.idiomatic: Twenty-eight days: initial number 4,043, initial approximate minutes 55.

sentences.zh: 上弦：九十一度、分三十一、秒四十三。

translations.literal: First quadrature: 91 degrees, minutes 31, seconds 43.
translations.idiomatic: First quadrature: 91°, 31′, 43″.

sentences.zh: 望：一百八十二度、分六十二、秒八十六。

translations.literal: Full moon: 182 degrees, minutes 62, seconds 86.

sentences.zh: 下弦：二百七十三度、分九十四、秒二十九。

translations.literal: Last quadrature: 273 degrees, minutes 94, seconds 29.
translations.idiomatic: Last quadrature: 273°, 94′, 29″.

sentences.zh: 月平行：十三度、分三十六、秒八十七太。

translations.literal: Mean lunar motion: 13 degrees, minutes 36, seconds 87 and an excess.
translations.idiomatic: Mean lunar daily motion: 13°, 36′, 87″ tai (with fractional excess).

sentences.zh: 已上分、秒母皆同一百。

translations.literal: For the above, minute and second divisors are each uniformly 100.
translations.idiomatic: For the above, minutes and seconds share the divisor 100.

sentences.zh: 求天正十一月經朔入轉：置天正十一月經朔加時積分，以轉周分及秒去之，不盡，滿日法除之為日，不滿為餘秒，命日，算外，即所求年天正十一月經朔加時入轉日及餘秒。

translations.literal: To find civil year eleventh month standard new moon entry into rotation: set civil year eleventh month standard new moon added-time accumulated parts; remove rotation circuit parts and seconds; what does not fill, divide by day divisor for days, what does not fill is remainder seconds; name the day, outside the count: thereby the sought year's civil eleventh month standard new moon added-time entry into rotation days and remainder seconds.
translations.idiomatic: To find entry into rotation at the civil eleventh month's standard new moon: from accumulated added-time parts, remove full rotation-circuit parts and seconds; divide remainder by day divisor for days, the rest is remainder-seconds; count from the day (outside the count) for the year's eleventh-month new-moon rotation entry.

sentences.zh: 若以朔差日及餘秒加之，滿轉周日及餘秒去之，即次朔加時入轉日。

translations.literal: If one adds new-moon difference days and remainder seconds and when full of rotation circuit days and remainder seconds removes them: thereby the next new moon's added-time entry into rotation day.
translations.idiomatic: Add new-moon difference days and remainder-seconds; subtract full rotation-circuit days and remainder-seconds for the next new moon's rotation entry day.

sentences.zh: 求弦望入轉：各因其月經朔加時入轉日及餘秒，以弦策累加之，去命如前，即上弦、望及下弦經日加時入轉日及餘秒。
