translations.literal: To find quadrature and full-moon entry into rotation: each from that month's standard new moon added-time entry into rotation day and remainder seconds, accumulate add quadrature stride and remove as before when naming: thereby first quadrature, full moon, and last quadrature standard-day added-time entry into rotation days and remainder seconds.
translations.idiomatic: For quadrature and full moon: from each month's new-moon rotation entry, accumulate the quadrature stride and reduce as before to obtain first quadrature, full moon, and last quadrature rotation entry days and remainder-seconds.

sentences.zh: 求朔弦望入轉朏朒定數：置入轉餘，以其日算外損益率乘之，如日法而一，所得，以損益其下朏朒積為定數。

translations.literal: To find new moon, quadrature, and full moon entry into rotation phase/defect fixed number: set rotation remainder; outside the count of that day multiply by excess-deficit rate; divide by day divisor for quotient; add or subtract to the phase/defect accumulation below for fixed number.
translations.idiomatic: To find fixed phase/defect (fei/si) numbers at new moon, quadrature, and full moon: from rotation remainder, multiply the excess-deficit rate outside that day's count, divide by day divisor, and apply to the phase/defect accumulation for the fixed value.

sentences.zh: 其四七日下余如初數已下者，初率乘之，初數而一，以損益朏朒為定數。

translations.literal: When within seven days the remainder is at or below the initial number, multiply by the initial rate and divide by the initial number; add or subtract phase/defect for fixed number.
translations.idiomatic: Within the first seven-day interval, if remainder is at or below the initial number, multiply by the initial rate, divide by the initial number, and adjust phase/defect for the fixed number.

sentences.zh: 如初數已上者，以初數減之，餘乘末率，末數而一，用減初率，餘加朏朒為定數。

translations.literal: When at or above the initial number, subtract the initial number; multiply remainder by the final rate; divide by the final number; subtract quotient from the initial rate; add remainder to phase/defect for fixed number.
translations.idiomatic: When remainder exceeds the initial number, subtract the initial number, multiply the rest by the final rate and divide by the final number; subtract that quotient from the initial rate and add the remainder to phase/defect for the fixed number.

sentences.zh: 其十四日下余如初數已上者，初數減之，餘乘末率，末數而一，為朏朒定數。

translations.literal: If under day fourteen the remainder is at or above the initial number, subtract the initial number; multiply the remainder by the final rate, divide by the final number, as the wane-wax fixed number.
translations.idiomatic: For days below fourteen, if the remainder is at or above the initial count, subtract the initial count, multiply the remainder by the final rate, divide by the final count, and take the result as the anomalistic fixed number.

sentences.zh: 求朔弦望定日：各置經朔、弦、望小餘，以入氣、入轉朏朒定數朏減朒加之，滿與不足，進退大餘，命己卯，算外，各得定日日辰及餘。

translations.literal: To find the fixed days of new, quarter, and full moon: for each set the mean new-, quarter-, and full-moon minor remainders; with the entered-qi and entered-rotation wane-wax fixed numbers, fast subtract and slow add; when full or insufficient, advance or retreat the major remainder; name from ji-mao, outside the count — each yields the fixed day, time, and remainder.
translations.idiomatic: To find fixed syzygy dates: set each mean syzygy minor remainder; apply the fixed anomalistic numbers for entered qi and rotation—subtract for fast, add for slow; carry or borrow the major remainder; count from ji-mao to obtain each fixed date, time, and remainder.

sentences.zh: 定朔幹名與後朔幹名同者月大，不同者月小，其月內無中氣者為閏月。

translations.literal: When the fixed new-moon stem name matches the following new moon, the month is long; when they differ, it is short; a month with no central qi within it is an intercalary month.
translations.idiomatic: When the fixed new-moon stem name matches the next new moon, the month is long; when they differ, it is short; a month containing no central qi is intercalary.

sentences.zh: 凡注曆，觀定朔小余，秋分後在日法四分之三已上者，進一日；

translations.literal: In annotating the calendar, observe the fixed new-moon minor remainder: after the Autumn Equinox, if it is three-fourths of the day divisor or above, advance one day;
translations.idiomatic: In calendar annotation, if the fixed new-moon minor remainder after the Autumn Equinox is three-fourths of the day divisor or more, advance the date one day;

sentences.zh: 春分後定朔日出分差如春分之日者，三約之，用減四分之三；

translations.literal: After the Spring Equinox, if the fixed new-moon sunrise-sunset difference equals that of the Spring Equinox day, divide by three and subtract from three-fourths;
translations.idiomatic: After the Spring Equinox, if the fixed new-moon sunrise-sunset difference equals that of the equinox day, divide by three and subtract from three-fourths;

sentences.zh: 定朔小餘及此數已上者，亦進一日；

translations.literal: if the fixed new-moon minor remainder reaches this number or above, also advance one day;
translations.idiomatic: if the fixed new-moon minor remainder reaches this threshold or above, also advance one day;

sentences.zh: 或當交虧初在日入已前者，其朔不進。

translations.literal: or when the eclipse onset at conjunction falls before sunset, the new moon is not advanced.
translations.idiomatic: or when eclipse onset at conjunction occurs before sunset, do not advance the new moon.

sentences.zh: 弦、望定小餘不滿日出分者，退一日；

translations.literal: If the fixed minor remainder at quarter or full moon does not fill the sunrise fraction, retreat one day;
translations.idiomatic: If the fixed minor remainder at quarter or full moon does not reach the sunrise fraction, set the date back one day;

sentences.zh: 望若有食虧初在日出已前者，定望小余進滿日出分，亦進一日。

translations.literal: If at full moon there is an eclipse and the onset of waning is before sunrise, and when the fixed full-moon minor remainder is advanced it fills the sunrise fraction, also advance one day.
translations.idiomatic: If a full-moon eclipse begins before sunrise and advancing the fixed full-moon minor remainder fills the sunrise fraction, also advance one day.

sentences.zh: 又月行九道遲疾，有三大二小；

translations.literal: Again, the moon’s motion in the nine paths has fast and slow phases, hence there are three long and two short months;
translations.idiomatic: Because the moon’s nine-path motion varies in speed, months naturally run three long and two short;

sentences.zh: 日行盈縮累增損之，則有四大三小，理數然也。

translations.literal: accumulating increase and decrease from the sun’s daily surplus and deficit, one may get four long and three short; the pattern of numbers allows this.
translations.idiomatic: cumulative adjustment by the sun’s daily equation of time can occasionally yield four long and three short months; the arithmetic permits it.

sentences.zh: 若俯循常儀，當察加時早晚，隨其所近而進退之，使不過三大二小。

translations.literal: If one follows the ordinary rule in practice, one should inspect whether the hour-added time is early or late and advance or retreat accordingly, so as not to exceed three long and two short.
translations.idiomatic: In practice, inspect whether the hour-added time is early or late and adjust accordingly, keeping within three long and two short months.

sentences.zh: 求定朔弦望加時日所在度：置定朔、弦、望約餘，副之，以乘其日盈縮分，萬約之，所得，盈加縮減其副，滿百為分，分滿百為度，以加其日夜半日度，命之，各得其日加時日躔黃道宿次。

translations.literal: To find the lodge degree at the hour-added time of fixed new, quarter, and full moon: set the reduced remainders of fixed new, quarter, and full moon and keep duplicates; multiply by that day’s surplus-deficit fraction and reduce by ten thousand; what is obtained, surplus adds and deficit subtracts from the duplicate; when parts fill one hundred they become degrees, and when degrees fill one hundred they become lodge degrees; add to that day’s midnight solar degree and name them — each yields the Yellow Path lodge position at the hour-added time of that day.
translations.idiomatic: To find the ecliptic lodge at fixed syzygy hour-addition: set each fixed syzygy reduced remainder and keep a duplicate; multiply by that day’s equation of time, divide by ten thousand, and add or subtract from the duplicate according to surplus or deficit; carry parts into degrees and degrees into lodge positions; add to that night’s midnight solar longitude and name the lodge—each yields the ecliptic lodge at syzygy hour-addition.

sentences.zh: 求平交日辰：置交終日及餘秒，以其月經朔加時入交泛日及餘秒減之，余為平交入其月經朔加時後日算及餘秒，以加減其月經朔大、小餘，其大餘命己卯，算外，即平交日辰及餘秒。

translations.literal: To find the mean-conjunction day and time: set the nodal-period days and remainder-seconds; subtract the mean new-moon hour-added entered-conjunction general days and remainder-seconds of that month; the remainder is the mean conjunction’s days and remainder-seconds after the month’s mean new-moon hour-added time; add or subtract to the month’s mean new-moon major and minor remainders; name the major remainder from ji-mao, outside the count — that is the mean-conjunction day, time, and remainder-seconds.
translations.idiomatic: To find mean node-crossing date and time: set the nodal-period days and remainder-seconds; subtract the month’s mean new-moon hour-added general conjunction entry; the remainder is days and seconds after mean new-moon hour-addition; adjust the month’s mean new-moon major and minor remainders; count from ji-mao to obtain mean node-crossing date, time, and remainder-seconds.

sentences.zh: 求次交者，以交終日及餘秒加之，大余滿紀法去之，命如前，即次平交日辰及餘秒。

translations.literal: To find the next conjunction, add the nodal-period days and remainder-seconds; when the major remainder fills the era divisor, remove it and name as before — that is the next mean-conjunction day, time, and remainder-seconds.
translations.idiomatic: For the next crossing, add the nodal-period days and remainder-seconds; when the major remainder fills the era divisor, remove it and name as before to obtain the next mean node-crossing date, time, and remainder-seconds.

sentences.zh: 求平交入轉朏朒定數：置平交小餘，加其日夜半入轉餘，以乘其日損益率，日法而一，所得，以損益其下朏朒積為定數。

translations.literal: To find the mean-conjunction entered-rotation wane-wax fixed number: set the mean-conjunction minor remainder; add its day-and-night midnight entered-rotation remainder; multiply by that day’s increase-decrease rate and divide by the day divisor; what is obtained is used to increase or decrease the wane-wax accumulation below it as the fixed number.
translations.idiomatic: To find the mean crossing’s rotation anomalistic fixed number: set the mean crossing minor remainder; add the day’s midnight rotation entry remainder; multiply by that day’s increase-decrease rate, divide by the day divisor, and adjust the anomalistic accumulation below to obtain the fixed number.

sentences.zh: 求正交日辰：置平交小余，以平交入轉朏朒定數朏減朒加之，滿與不足，進退日辰，即正交日辰及餘秒；

translations.literal: To find the true-conjunction day and time: set the mean-conjunction minor remainder; with the mean-conjunction entered-rotation wane-wax fixed number, fast subtract and slow add; when full or insufficient, advance or retreat the day and time — that is the true-conjunction day, time, and remainder-seconds;
translations.idiomatic: To find true node-crossing date and time: set the mean crossing minor remainder; apply the rotation anomalistic fixed number—subtract for fast, add for slow; carry or borrow days and seconds to obtain true node-crossing date, time, and remainder-seconds;

sentences.zh: 與定朔日辰相距，即所在月日。

translations.literal: compare its distance from the fixed new-moon day and time — that is the month and day where it falls.
translations.idiomatic: compare its offset from the fixed new-moon date and time to determine the month and day of occurrence.

sentences.zh: 求經朔加時中積：各以其月經朔加時入氣日及餘，加其氣中積及餘，其日命為度，其餘以日法退除為分秒，即其月經朔加時中積度及分秒。

translations.literal: To find the central accumulated degree at mean new-moon hour-added time: for each add that month’s mean new-moon hour-added entered-qi days and remainder to its qi central accumulation and remainder; name the days as degrees, and retreat-divide the remainder by the day divisor for parts and seconds — that is the central accumulated degree, parts, and seconds at that month’s mean new-moon hour-added time.
translations.idiomatic: To find central accumulated longitude at mean new-moon hour-addition: add each month’s mean new-moon entered-qi days and remainder to its qi central accumulation; convert days to degrees and the remainder to parts and seconds by the day divisor to obtain central accumulated longitude at mean new-moon hour-addition.

sentences.zh: 求正交加時黃道月度：置平交入經朔加時後日算及約餘秒，以日法通日，內餘，進一位，如五千四百五十三而一為度，不滿，退除為分秒，以加其月經朔加時中積，然後以冬至加時黃道日度加而命之，即得其月正加時月離黃道宿度及分秒。

translations.literal: To find the Yellow Path lunar degree at true-conjunction hour-added time: set the day-count and reduced remainder-seconds after mean new-moon hour-added time at mean conjunction; convert days through the day divisor and include the remainder, advance one place, divide by 5453 for degrees; what does not fill, retreat-divide for parts and seconds; add to the central accumulated degree at that month’s mean new-moon hour-added time; then add and name from the winter-solstice hour-added Yellow Path solar degree — that yields that month’s true-conjunction hour-added lunar departure in Yellow Path lodge degrees, parts, and seconds.
translations.idiomatic: To find ecliptic lunar longitude at true-conjunction hour-addition: set days and reduced seconds after mean new-moon hour-addition at mean crossing; convert through the day divisor, advance one place, and divide by 5453 for degrees; convert the remainder to parts and seconds; add to mean new-moon hour-added central accumulation; then add and name from the winter-solstice hour-added ecliptic solar degree to obtain true-conjunction hour-added lunar ecliptic lodge longitude.

sentences.zh: 如求次交者，以交終度及分秒加而命之，即得所求。

translations.literal: To find the next conjunction, add the nodal-period degrees, parts, and seconds and name them — that is what is sought.
translations.idiomatic: For the next crossing, add the nodal-period degrees, parts, and seconds and name the lodge to obtain the result.

sentences.zh: 求黃道宿積度：置正交加時黃道宿全度，以正交加時月離黃道宿度及分秒減之，餘為距後度及分秒，以黃道宿度累加之，即各得正交後黃道宿積度及分秒。

translations.literal: To find Yellow Path lodge accumulated degrees: set the full Yellow Path lodge degree at true-conjunction hour-added time; subtract the lunar departure in Yellow Path lodge degrees, parts, and seconds at true-conjunction hour-added time; the remainder is the post-distance degrees, parts, and seconds; accumulate by adding Yellow Path lodge degrees — each yields the post-true-conjunction Yellow Path lodge accumulated degrees, parts, and seconds.
translations.idiomatic: To find ecliptic lodge accumulated longitude: set the full ecliptic lodge at true-conjunction hour-addition; subtract the lunar ecliptic lodge longitude there; the remainder is post-distance longitude; accumulate by adding lodge degrees to obtain post-true-conjunction ecliptic accumulated longitude.

sentences.zh: 求黃道宿積度入初末限：各置黃道宿積度及分秒，滿交象度及分去之，在半交象已下為初限；

translations.literal: To find whether Yellow Path lodge accumulated degrees enter the initial or final limit: for each set the Yellow Path lodge accumulated degrees, parts, and seconds; when they fill the conjunction-image degrees and parts, remove them — if at or below half the conjunction image, it is the initial limit;
translations.idiomatic: To determine initial or final limit for ecliptic accumulated longitude: set accumulated degrees, parts, and seconds; remove full conjunction-image intervals—at or below half the conjunction image is the initial limit;

sentences.zh: 已上者，以減交象度，餘為入末限。

translations.literal: if above, subtract from the conjunction-image degrees; the remainder is entry into the final limit.
translations.idiomatic: if above, subtract from the conjunction-image interval; the remainder is entry into the final limit.

sentences.zh: 入交積度、交象度並在交會術中。

translations.literal: Entered-conjunction accumulated degrees and conjunction-image degrees are both in the conjunction method.
translations.idiomatic: Entered-conjunction accumulated degrees and conjunction-image degrees are both defined in the conjunction procedure.

sentences.zh: 求月行九道宿度：凡月行所交，冬入陰曆，夏入陽曆，月行青道。

translations.literal: To find the lodge degrees of the moon’s nine-path motion: wherever the moon’s path crosses, in winter it enters yin months and in summer yang months, and the moon follows the green path.
translations.idiomatic: To find nine-path lodge degrees: at each crossing, in winter the moon enters yin months and in summer yang months, following the green path.

sentences.zh: 冬至、夏至後，青道半交在春分之宿，當黃道東；

translations.literal: After the Winter and Summer Solstices, the green path’s half-intersection lies in the spring-equinox lodge, east of the Yellow Path;
translations.idiomatic: After the Winter and Summer Solstices, the green path’s half-intersection lies at the spring-equinox lodge, east of the ecliptic;

sentences.zh: 立冬、立夏後，青道半交在立春之宿，當黃道東南：至所沖之宿亦如之。

translations.literal: after Start of Winter and Start of Summer, the green path’s half-intersection lies in the Start-of-Spring lodge, southeast of the Yellow Path — at the opposing lodge, likewise.
translations.idiomatic: after Start of Winter and Start of Summer, the green path’s half-intersection lies at the Start-of-Spring lodge, southeast of the ecliptic—at the opposing lodge, the same applies.

sentences.zh: 冬入陽曆，夏入陰曆，月行白道。

translations.literal: In winter it enters yang months and in summer yin months, and the moon follows the white path.
translations.idiomatic: In winter it enters yang months and in summer yin months, and the moon follows the white path.

sentences.zh: 冬至、夏至後，白道半交在秋分之宿，當黃道西；

translations.literal: After the Winter and Summer Solstices, the white path’s half-intersection lies in the autumn-equinox lodge, west of the Yellow Path;
translations.idiomatic: After the Winter and Summer Solstices, the white path’s half-intersection lies at the autumn-equinox lodge, west of the ecliptic;

sentences.zh: 立冬、立夏後，白道半交在立秋之宿，當黃道西北：至所沖之宿亦如之。

translations.literal: after Start of Winter and Start of Summer, the white path’s half-intersection lies in the Start-of-Autumn lodge, northwest of the Yellow Path — at the opposing lodge, likewise.
translations.idiomatic: after Start of Winter and Start of Summer, the white path’s half-intersection lies at the Start-of-Autumn lodge, northwest of the ecliptic—at the opposing lodge, the same applies.

sentences.zh: 春入陽曆，秋入陰曆，月行朱道。

translations.literal: In spring it enters yang months and in autumn yin months, and the moon follows the vermillion path.
translations.idiomatic: In spring it enters yang months and in autumn yin months, and the moon follows the vermillion path.

sentences.zh: 春分、秋分後，朱道半交在夏至之宿，當黃道南；

translations.literal: After the Spring and Autumn Equinoxes, the vermillion path’s half-intersection lies in the summer-solstice lodge, south of the Yellow Path;
translations.idiomatic: After the Spring and Autumn Equinoxes, the vermillion path’s half-intersection lies at the summer-solstice lodge, south of the ecliptic;

sentences.zh: 立春、立秋後，朱道半交在立夏之宿，當黃道西南：至所沖之宿亦如之。

translations.literal: after Start of Spring and Start of Autumn, the vermillion path’s half-intersection lies in the Start-of-Summer lodge, southwest of the Yellow Path — at the opposing lodge, likewise.
translations.idiomatic: after Start of Spring and Start of Autumn, the vermillion path’s half-intersection lies at the Start-of-Summer lodge, southwest of the ecliptic—at the opposing lodge, the same applies.

sentences.zh: 春入陰曆，秋入陽曆，月行黑道。

translations.literal: In spring it enters yin months and in autumn yang months, and the moon follows the black path.
translations.idiomatic: In spring it enters yin months and in autumn yang months, and the moon follows the black path.

sentences.zh: 春分、秋分後，黑道半交在冬至之宿，當黃道北；

translations.literal: After the Spring and Autumn Equinoxes, the black path’s half-intersection lies in the winter-solstice lodge, north of the Yellow Path;
translations.idiomatic: After the Spring and Autumn Equinoxes, the black path’s half-intersection lies at the winter-solstice lodge, north of the ecliptic;

sentences.zh: 立春、立秋後，黑道半交在立冬之宿，當黃道東北：至所沖之宿亦如之。

translations.literal: after Start of Spring and Start of Autumn, the black path’s half-intersection lies in the Start-of-Winter lodge, northeast of the Yellow Path — at the opposing lodge, likewise.
translations.idiomatic: after Start of Spring and Start of Autumn, the black path’s half-intersection lies at the Start-of-Winter lodge, northeast of the ecliptic—at the opposing lodge, the same applies.

sentences.zh: 四序離為八節，至陰陽之所交，皆與黃道相會，故月行有九道。

translations.literal: The four seasons divide into eight nodes; where yin and yang cross, all meet the Yellow Path — hence the moon has nine paths.
translations.idiomatic: The four seasons yield eight nodes; at each yin–yang crossing the moon meets the ecliptic—hence nine paths of lunar motion.

sentences.zh: 各以所入初、末限度及分減一百一度，餘以所入初、末限度及分乘之，半而退位為分，分滿百為度，命為月道與黃道泛差。

translations.literal: For each, subtract the initial or final limit degrees and parts from 101 degrees; multiply the remainder by the initial or final limit degrees and parts; halve and retreat one place for parts; when parts fill one hundred they become degrees — name this the general difference between the lunar path and the Yellow Path.
translations.idiomatic: For each, subtract the initial or final limit from 101°; multiply the remainder by that limit; halve and shift one place for parts; carry parts into degrees—this is the general lunar–ecliptic latitude difference.

sentences.zh: 凡日以赤道內為陰，外為陽；

translations.literal: For the sun, inside the equator is yin and outside is yang;
translations.idiomatic: For the sun, inside the equator is yin and outside is yang;

sentences.zh: 月以黃道內為陰、外為陽。

translations.literal: for the moon, inside the Yellow Path is yin and outside is yang.
translations.idiomatic: for the moon, inside the ecliptic is yin and outside is yang.

sentences.zh: 故月行正交，入夏至後宿度內為同名，入冬至後宿度內為異名。

translations.literal: Hence at true conjunction, when entering lodge degrees after the Summer Solstice within the path, it is same name; when entering lodge degrees after the Winter Solstice within the path, it is different name.
translations.idiomatic: Hence at true conjunction, entry after the Summer Solstice within the path is same-named; entry after the Winter Solstice within the path is differently named.

sentences.zh: 其在同名者，置月行與黃道泛差，九因八約之，為定差。

translations.literal: In the same-name case, set the general difference between lunar motion and the Yellow Path; multiply by nine and reduce by eight — that is the fixed difference.
translations.idiomatic: When same-named, set the general lunar–ecliptic difference; multiply by nine and reduce by eight to obtain the fixed difference.

sentences.zh: 半交後、正交前以差減，正交後、半交前以差加。

translations.literal: After half-intersection and before true conjunction subtract the difference; after true conjunction and before half-intersection add the difference.
translations.idiomatic: Between half-intersection and true conjunction subtract the difference; between true conjunction and half-intersection add it.

sentences.zh: 此加減出入六度，正如黃、赤道相交同名之差。

translations.literal: This increase and decrease shifts in and out by six degrees — just like the same-name difference at Yellow Path and equator intersection.
translations.idiomatic: This adjustment shifts latitude by six degrees—matching the same-name difference at ecliptic–equator crossing.

sentences.zh: 若較之漸異，則隨交所在，遷變不常。

translations.literal: If compared gradually they differ, then according to where the conjunction falls, the shift varies and is not constant.
translations.idiomatic: Compared incrementally they diverge; the adjustment varies with the conjunction position and is not constant.

sentences.zh: 仍以正交度距秋分度數乘定差，如象限而一，所得，為月道與赤道定差，前加者為減，減者為加。

translations.literal: Still multiply the fixed difference by the true-conjunction degree’s distance from the autumn-equinox degree; as one per quadrant — what is obtained is the fixed difference between the lunar path and the equator; what was added becomes subtracted and what was subtracted becomes added.
translations.idiomatic: Multiply the fixed difference by the true-conjunction degree’s distance from the autumn equinox and divide by a quadrant to obtain the fixed lunar–equator difference; reverse prior addition and subtraction.

sentences.zh: 其在異名者，置月行與黃道泛差，七因八約之，為定差；

translations.literal: In the different-name case, set the general difference between lunar motion and the Yellow Path; multiply by seven and reduce by eight — that is the fixed difference;
translations.idiomatic: When differently named, set the general lunar–ecliptic difference; multiply by seven and reduce by eight for the fixed difference;

sentences.zh: 半交後、正交前以差加，正交後、半交前以差減。

translations.literal: after half-intersection and before true conjunction add the difference; after true conjunction and before half-intersection subtract the difference.
translations.idiomatic: between half-intersection and true conjunction add the difference; between true conjunction and half-intersection subtract it.

sentences.zh: 此加減出入六度，異如黃赤道相交異名之差，若較之漸同，則隨交所在，遷變不常。

translations.literal: This increase and decrease shifts in and out by six degrees — unlike the different-name difference at Yellow Path and equator intersection; if compared gradually they converge, then according to where the conjunction falls, the shift varies and is not constant.
translations.idiomatic: This adjustment shifts latitude by six degrees—unlike the different-name ecliptic–equator difference; compared incrementally they converge, yet the adjustment still varies with conjunction position.

sentences.zh: 仍以正交度距春分度數乘定差，如象限而一，所得，為月行與赤道定差，前加者為減，減者為加；

translations.literal: Still multiply the fixed difference by the true-conjunction degree’s distance from the spring-equinox degree; as one per quadrant — what is obtained is the fixed difference between lunar motion and the equator; what was added becomes subtracted and what was subtracted becomes added;
translations.idiomatic: Multiply the fixed difference by the true-conjunction degree’s distance from the spring equinox and divide by a quadrant to obtain the fixed lunar–equator difference; reverse prior addition and subtraction;

sentences.zh: 皆加減黃道宿積度，為九道宿積度；

translations.literal: in each case add or subtract to the Yellow Path lodge accumulated degrees to obtain nine-path lodge accumulated degrees;
translations.idiomatic: add or subtract both differences from ecliptic accumulated longitude to obtain nine-path accumulated longitude;

sentences.zh: 以前宿九道積度減之，為其宿九道度及分。

translations.literal: subtract from this the nine-path accumulated degrees of the preceding lodge — that is the nine-path degree and parts of that lodge.
translations.idiomatic: subtract the preceding lodge’s nine-path accumulated longitude to obtain that lodge’s nine-path degree and parts.

sentences.zh: 其分就近約為太、半、少。

translations.literal: Reduce the parts to the nearest major, half, or minor fraction.
translations.idiomatic: Round parts to the nearest major, half, or minor fraction.

sentences.zh: 論春、夏、秋、冬，以四時日所在宿度為正。

translations.literal: Discussing spring, summer, autumn, and winter, take the lodge degree where the sun stands in each season as standard.
translations.idiomatic: For the four seasons, take the solar lodge at each season’s position as the standard.

sentences.zh: 求正交加時月離九道宿度：以正交加時黃道日度及分減一百一度，餘以正交度及分乘之，半而退位為分，分滿百為度，命為月道與黃道泛差。

translations.literal: To find the nine-path lodge degree of lunar departure at true-conjunction hour-added time: subtract 101 degrees from the Yellow Path solar degree and parts at true-conjunction hour-added time; multiply the remainder by the true-conjunction degrees and parts; halve and retreat one place for parts; when parts fill one hundred they become degrees — name this the general difference between the lunar path and the Yellow Path.
translations.idiomatic: To find nine-path lodge longitude at true-conjunction hour-addition: subtract 101° from the hour-added ecliptic solar degree; multiply the remainder by the true-conjunction degree; halve and shift for parts; carry into degrees—this is the general lunar–ecliptic difference.

sentences.zh: 其在同名者，置月行與黃道泛差，九因八約之，為定差，以加；

translations.literal: In the same-name case, set the general difference between lunar motion and the Yellow Path; multiply by nine and reduce by eight — that is the fixed difference, and add it;
translations.idiomatic: When same-named, set the general lunar–ecliptic difference; multiply by nine and reduce by eight for the fixed difference, and add it;

sentences.zh: 仍以正交度距秋分度數乘定差，如象限而一，所得，為月道與赤道定差，以減。

translations.literal: still multiply the fixed difference by the true-conjunction degree’s distance from the autumn-equinox degree; as one per quadrant — what is obtained is the fixed difference between the lunar path and the equator, and subtract it.
translations.idiomatic: multiply the fixed difference by the true-conjunction degree’s distance from the autumn equinox, divide by a quadrant for the fixed lunar–equator difference, and subtract it.

sentences.zh: 其在異名者，置月行與黃道泛差，七因八約之，為定差，以減；

translations.literal: In the different-name case, set the general difference between lunar motion and the Yellow Path; multiply by seven and reduce by eight — that is the fixed difference, and subtract it;
translations.idiomatic: When differently named, set the general lunar–ecliptic difference; multiply by seven and reduce by eight for the fixed difference, and subtract it;

sentences.zh: 仍以正交度距春分度數乘定差，如象限而一，所得，為月道與赤道定差，以加。

translations.literal: still multiply the fixed difference by the true-conjunction degree’s distance from the spring-equinox degree; as one per quadrant — what is obtained is the fixed difference between lunar motion and the equator, and add it.
translations.idiomatic: multiply the fixed difference by the true-conjunction degree’s distance from the spring equinox, divide by a quadrant for the fixed lunar–equator difference, and add it.

sentences.zh: 置正交加時黃道月度及分，以二差加減之，即正交加時月離九道宿度及分。

translations.literal: Set the Yellow Path lunar degree and parts at true-conjunction hour-added time; add or subtract the two differences — that is the nine-path lodge degree and parts of lunar departure at true-conjunction hour-added time.
translations.idiomatic: Set the hour-added ecliptic lunar degree; apply both differences to obtain the nine-path lodge longitude at true-conjunction hour-addition.

sentences.zh: 求定朔弦望加時月所在度：置定朔加時日躔黃道宿次，凡合朔加時，月行潛在日下，與太陽同度，是為加時月離宿次；

translations.literal: To find the lunar degree at the hour-added time of fixed new, quarter, and full moon: set the Yellow Path lodge position at fixed new-moon hour-added solar transit; at syzygy hour-added time the moon moves hidden beneath the sun at the same degree — this is the hour-added lunar lodge position;
translations.idiomatic: To find lunar longitude at fixed syzygy hour-addition: set the ecliptic lodge at fixed new-moon hour-added solar transit; at conjunction hour-addition the moon lies hidden beneath the sun at the same longitude—this is the hour-added lunar lodge;

sentences.zh: 各以弦、望度及分秒加其所當弦、望加時日躔黃道宿度，滿宿次去之，命如前，各得定朔、弦、望加時月所在黃道宿度及分秒。

translations.literal: for each add the quarter- or full-moon degrees, parts, and seconds to the Yellow Path solar degree at the corresponding quarter- or full-moon hour-added solar transit; when lodge positions fill, remove them and name as before — each yields the Yellow Path lodge degree, parts, and seconds of the moon at fixed new-, quarter-, and full-moon hour-added time.
translations.idiomatic: add each quarter- or full-moon interval to the corresponding hour-added ecliptic solar longitude; carry lodge positions and name as before to obtain ecliptic lunar longitude at each fixed syzygy hour-addition.

sentences.zh: 求定朔弦望加時九道月度：各以定朔、弦、望加時月離黃道宿度及分秒，加前宿正交後黃道積度，為定朔、弦、望加時正交後黃道積度。

translations.literal: To find the nine-path lunar degree at fixed new-, quarter-, and full-moon hour-added time: for each add the Yellow Path lodge degree, parts, and seconds of lunar departure at fixed new-, quarter-, and full-moon hour-added time to the post-true-conjunction Yellow Path accumulated degrees of the preceding lodge, as the post-true-conjunction Yellow Path accumulated degrees at fixed new-, quarter-, and full-moon hour-added time.
translations.idiomatic: To find nine-path lunar longitude at fixed syzygy hour-addition: add each hour-added ecliptic lunar longitude to the preceding lodge’s post-true-conjunction ecliptic accumulation.

sentences.zh: 如前求九道積度，以前宿九道積度減之，餘為定朔、弦、望加時九道月離宿度及分秒。

translations.literal: As before in finding nine-path accumulated degrees, subtract the nine-path accumulated degrees of the preceding lodge — the remainder is the nine-path lunar lodge degree, parts, and seconds at fixed new-, quarter-, and full-moon hour-added time.
translations.idiomatic: As in the nine-path accumulation procedure, subtract the preceding lodge’s nine-path accumulation to obtain nine-path lunar longitude at fixed syzygy hour-addition.

sentences.zh: 其合朔加時若非正交，則日在黃道、月在九道。

translations.literal: If at syzygy hour-added time it is not true conjunction, then the sun is on the Yellow Path and the moon on the nine paths.
translations.idiomatic: If syzygy hour-addition is not true conjunction, the sun remains on the ecliptic and the moon on the nine paths.

sentences.zh: 所入宿度雖多少不同，考其兩極，若應繩准，故云月行潛在日下，與太陽同度。

translations.literal: Although the entered lodge degrees differ in magnitude, examining the two poles, they answer to the plumb line — hence it is said the moon moves hidden beneath the sun at the same degree.
translations.idiomatic: Though lodge longitudes differ, their polar distances align to the plumb line—hence the moon moves hidden beneath the sun at the same longitude.

sentences.zh: 求定朔午中入轉：以經朔小餘與半法相減，餘以加減經朔加時入轉，經朔小餘少，如半法加之；

translations.literal: To find entered rotation at noon of fixed new moon: subtract the mean new-moon minor remainder from the half divisor; use the remainder to add or subtract to mean new-moon hour-added entered rotation; if the mean new-moon minor remainder is less, add as if to the half divisor;
translations.idiomatic: To find noon rotation entry at fixed new moon: subtract the mean new-moon minor remainder from the half divisor and use the result to adjust mean new-moon hour-added rotation entry; if the minor remainder is smaller, add toward the half divisor;

sentences.zh: 多，如半法減之。

translations.literal: if greater, subtract as if from the half divisor.
translations.idiomatic: if larger, subtract toward the half divisor.

sentences.zh: 為經朔午中入轉。

translations.literal: This is entered rotation at noon of mean new moon.
translations.idiomatic: This is mean new-moon noon rotation entry.

sentences.zh: 若定朔大餘有進退，亦加減轉日，否則因經為定，命日，算外，即得所求。

translations.literal: If the fixed new-moon major remainder has advance or retreat, also add or subtract the rotation day; otherwise follow the mean as fixed, name the day, outside the count — that is what is sought.
translations.idiomatic: If the fixed new-moon major remainder advances or retreats, adjust the rotation day likewise; otherwise take the mean value as fixed, name the day, and count outward to obtain the result.

sentences.zh: 次月仿此求之。

translations.literal: For the following month, find it by the same method.
translations.idiomatic: For the following month, repeat the same procedure.

sentences.zh: 求每日午中入轉：因定朔午中入轉日及餘秒，每日累加一日，滿轉周日及餘秒去之，命如前，即得每日午中入轉日及餘秒。

translations.literal: To find entered rotation at noon of each day: from the fixed new-moon noon entered-rotation days and remainder-seconds, accumulate by adding one day each day; when they fill the rotation-cycle days and remainder-seconds, remove them and name as before — that yields entered-rotation days and remainder-seconds at noon of each day.
translations.idiomatic: To find daily noon rotation entry: from fixed new-moon noon rotation days and seconds, add one day per day; when the rotation-cycle interval is filled, remove it and name as before to obtain each day’s noon rotation entry.

sentences.zh: 求晨昏月度：置其日晨分，乘其日算外轉定分，日法而一，為晨轉分；

translations.literal: To find morning and evening lunar degrees: set that day’s morning fraction; multiply the rotation fixed parts outside the day-count by it and divide by the day divisor — that is the morning rotation parts;
translations.idiomatic: To find morning and evening lunar longitude: set that day’s morning fraction; multiply the day’s rotation fixed parts by it and divide by the day divisor for morning rotation parts;

sentences.zh: 用減轉定分，餘為昏轉分；

translations.literal: subtract from the rotation fixed parts — the remainder is the evening rotation parts;
translations.idiomatic: subtract from the rotation fixed parts to obtain evening rotation parts;

sentences.zh: 又以朔、弦、望定小餘乘轉定分，日法而一，為加時分；

translations.literal: again multiply the fixed minor remainder of new, quarter, or full moon by the rotation fixed parts and divide by the day divisor — that is the hour-added parts;
translations.idiomatic: multiply the fixed syzygy minor remainder by the rotation fixed parts and divide by the day divisor for hour-added parts;

sentences.zh: 以減晨昏轉分，為前；

translations.literal: subtract from the morning and evening rotation parts — that is the before portion;
translations.idiomatic: subtract from the morning and evening rotation parts for the before portion;

sentences.zh: 不足，覆減之，餘為後；

translations.literal: if insufficient, wrap and subtract; the remainder is the after portion;
translations.idiomatic: if insufficient, wrap around and subtract; the remainder is the after portion;

sentences.zh: 乃前加後減加時月度，即晨、昏月所在宿度及分秒。

translations.literal: then add the before portion and subtract the after portion from the hour-added lunar degree — that is the lodge degree, parts, and seconds where the moon stands at morning and evening.
translations.idiomatic: add the before portion and subtract the after portion from hour-added lunar longitude to obtain morning and evening lunar lodge positions.

sentences.zh: 求朔弦望晨昏定程：各以其朔昏定月減上弦昏定月，餘為朔後昏定程；

translations.literal: To find the fixed morning-and-evening intervals of new, quarter, and full moon: subtract the upper-quarter evening fixed moon from the new-moon evening fixed moon — the remainder is the fixed evening interval after new moon;
translations.idiomatic: To find fixed morning-and-evening intervals at syzygies: subtract upper-quarter evening longitude from new-moon evening longitude for the post-new-moon evening interval;

sentences.zh: 以上弦昏定月減望昏定月，餘為上弦後昏定程；

translations.literal: subtract the full-moon evening fixed moon from the upper-quarter evening fixed moon — the remainder is the fixed evening interval after upper quarter;
translations.idiomatic: subtract full-moon evening longitude from upper-quarter evening longitude for the post-upper-quarter evening interval;

sentences.zh: 以望晨定月減下弦晨定月，餘為望後晨定程；

translations.literal: subtract the last-quarter morning fixed moon from the full-moon morning fixed moon — the remainder is the fixed morning interval after full moon;
translations.idiomatic: subtract last-quarter morning longitude from full-moon morning longitude for the post-full-moon morning interval;

sentences.zh: 以下弦晨定月減後朔晨定月，餘為下弦後晨定程。

translations.literal: subtract the next new-moon morning fixed moon from the last-quarter morning fixed moon — the remainder is the fixed morning interval after last quarter.
translations.idiomatic: subtract the next new-moon morning longitude from last-quarter morning longitude for the post-last-quarter morning interval.

sentences.zh: 求每日轉定度：累計每程相距日轉定分，與晨昏定程相減，餘以相距日數除之，為日差；

translations.literal: To find the daily rotation fixed degrees: accumulate the daily rotation fixed parts over the days between intervals and subtract from the morning-and-evening fixed interval; divide the remainder by the number of intervening days — that is the daily difference;
translations.idiomatic: To find daily rotation fixed degrees: accumulate daily rotation fixed parts over the interval and subtract from the fixed morning-and-evening interval; divide the remainder by intervening days for the daily difference;

sentences.zh: 定程多為加，定程少為減。

translations.literal: when the fixed interval is larger, add; when smaller, subtract.
translations.idiomatic: add when the fixed interval is larger and subtract when it is smaller.

sentences.zh: 以加減每日轉定分，為每日轉定度及分秒。

translations.literal: Add or subtract the daily difference to each day’s rotation fixed parts — that is the daily rotation fixed degrees, parts, and seconds.
translations.idiomatic: Apply the daily difference to each day’s rotation fixed parts to obtain daily rotation fixed degrees, parts, and seconds.

sentences.zh: 求每日晨昏月：因朔、弦、望晨昏月，加每日轉定度及分秒，滿宿次去之，為每日晨昏月。

translations.literal: To find the morning and evening moon of each day: from the morning and evening moon at new, quarter, and full moon, add the daily rotation fixed degrees, parts, and seconds; when lodge positions fill, remove them — that is the morning and evening moon of each day.
translations.idiomatic: To find daily morning and evening lunar positions: from syzygy morning and evening longitudes, add daily rotation fixed degrees; carry lodge positions to obtain each day’s morning and evening moon.

sentences.zh: 凡注曆，目朔日注昏月，望後次日注晨月。

translations.literal: In annotating the calendar, on new-moon day record the evening moon; after full moon, record the morning moon on the following day.
translations.idiomatic: In calendar annotation, record the evening moon on new-moon day and the morning moon on the day after full moon.

sentences.zh: 已前月度以究算術之精微，如求其速要，即依後術徑求。

translations.literal: The lunar degrees above exhaust the refinements of calculation; if one seeks only speed and essentials, follow the later method and find them directly.
translations.idiomatic: The preceding lunar-longitude methods exhaust computational refinement; for a quick result, use the shortcut procedure below.

sentences.zh: 求經朔加時平行月：各以其月經朔入氣日及余秒，其餘以日法退除為分秒。

translations.literal: To find the mean moon at mean new-moon hour-added time: for each set that month’s mean new-moon entered-qi days and remainder-seconds; retreat-divide the remainder by the day divisor for parts and seconds.
translations.idiomatic: To find mean lunar longitude at mean new-moon hour-addition: set each month’s mean new-moon entered-qi days and remainder-seconds; convert the remainder to parts and seconds by the day divisor.

sentences.zh: 加其氣中積日及約分，命日為度，即為經朔加時平行月積度及分秒。

translations.literal: Add its qi central accumulated days and reduced parts; name the days as degrees — that is the mean moon accumulated degrees, parts, and seconds at mean new-moon hour-added time.
translations.idiomatic: Add qi central accumulated days and reduced parts; convert days to degrees to obtain mean lunar accumulated longitude at mean new-moon hour-addition.

sentences.zh: 求所求日加時平行月：置所求日大余及加時小餘，以其月經朔大、小餘減之，餘為入經朔加時後日數及餘；

translations.literal: To find the mean moon at the hour-added time of the day sought: set the major remainder and hour-added minor remainder of the day sought; subtract the month’s mean new-moon major and minor remainders — the remainder is the days and remainder after mean new-moon hour-added time;
translations.idiomatic: To find mean lunar longitude at the sought day’s hour-addition: set the sought day’s major remainder and hour-added minor remainder; subtract the month’s mean new-moon remainders to obtain days and remainder after mean new-moon hour-addition;

sentences.zh: 以其日乘月平行度及分秒，列於上位，又以其餘乘月平行度及分秒，滿日法除之為度，不滿，退除為分秒，並上位，用加經朔加時平行月，滿周天度及分秒去之，即得所求日加時平行月積度及分秒。

translations.literal: multiply the mean lunar degrees, parts, and seconds of that day by the day-count and array them in the upper position; again multiply the mean lunar degrees, parts, and seconds by the remainder; when full of the day divisor, divide for degrees — what does not fill, retreat-divide for parts and seconds; combine with the upper position and add to the mean moon at mean new-moon hour-added time; when full of the circuit of heaven degrees, parts, and seconds, remove them — that yields the mean moon accumulated degrees, parts, and seconds at the hour-added time of the day sought.
translations.idiomatic: multiply mean lunar motion by the day-count in the upper position and by the remainder; divide by the day divisor for degrees and convert the remainder to parts and seconds; add to mean new-moon hour-added mean longitude and remove full circuit intervals to obtain mean lunar accumulated longitude at the sought hour-addition.

sentences.zh: 求所求日加時入轉：以所求日加時入經朔加時後日數及餘，加經朔加時入轉日及余秒，滿轉周日及餘秒去之，命日，算外，即得所求。

translations.literal: To find entered rotation at the hour-added time of the day sought: add the days and remainder after mean new-moon hour-added time at the hour-added time of the day sought to the mean new-moon hour-added entered-rotation days and remainder-seconds; when they fill the rotation-cycle days and remainder-seconds, remove them; name the day, outside the count — that is what is sought.
translations.idiomatic: To find rotation entry at the sought hour-addition: add days and remainder after mean new-moon hour-addition to mean new-moon hour-added rotation entry; remove full rotation-cycle intervals; name the day and count outward to obtain the result.

sentences.zh: 其餘先以日法退除為分秒。

translations.literal: For the remainder, first retreat-divide by the day divisor for parts and seconds.
translations.idiomatic: First convert the remainder to parts and seconds by the day divisor.

sentences.zh: 求所求日加時定月：置所求日加時入轉分，以其日算外加減差乘之，百約為分，分滿百為度，加減其下遲疾度，為遲疾定度；

translations.literal: To find the true moon at the hour-added time of the day sought: set the hour-added entered-rotation parts of the day sought; multiply by the increase-decrease difference outside the day-count; reduce by one hundred for parts; when parts fill one hundred they become degrees; add or subtract to the fast-slow degrees below — that is the fixed fast-slow degree;
translations.idiomatic: To find true lunar longitude at the sought hour-addition: set hour-added rotation parts; multiply by the day’s increase-decrease difference outside the day-count; divide by one hundred for parts and carry into degrees; adjust the fast-slow degree below to obtain the fixed fast-slow degree;

sentences.zh: 乃以遲減疾加所求日加時平行月，為定月。

translations.literal: then slow subtracts and fast adds to the mean moon at the hour-added time of the day sought — that is the true moon.
translations.idiomatic: then subtract for slow and add for fast to the hour-added mean moon to obtain the true moon.

sentences.zh: 各以天正冬至加時黃道日度加而命之，即得所求日加時月離黃道宿度及分秒。

translations.literal: For each add and name from the winter-solstice hour-added Yellow Path solar degree — that yields the lunar departure in Yellow Path lodge degrees, parts, and seconds at the hour-added time of the day sought.
translations.idiomatic: Add and name from the winter-solstice hour-added ecliptic solar degree to obtain ecliptic lunar lodge longitude at the sought hour-addition.

sentences.zh: 其入轉若在四、七日者，如求朏朒術入之。

translations.literal: If entered rotation falls on days four or seven, apply the wane-wax method as in finding it.
translations.idiomatic: If rotation entry falls on days four or seven, apply the anomalistic procedure as above.
